About this edition

Text. The Lalitā Sahasranāma of the Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa (Uttara-khaṇḍa), the dialogue of Hayagrīva and Agastya, divided into 1,000 names as Bhāskararāya divides them in the Saubhāgyabhāskara. The base is the stotra text this site has published since it began (sanskritdocuments.org), corrected name by name. It was checked against an independently published copy of the same recension (the hindu-devotional-texts package, Devanagari) and against the metre: every half-śloka of an anuṣṭubh has 16 syllables, and all 366 half-lines here do, so no akṣara is missing or extra.

What was corrected. Misspelt names, names split or joined wrongly, a name whose second half had been moved into its meaning (454), names shown under the wrong śloka on the website (ślokas 41–42, 53–56, 104–105, 117–120, 125–126, 144–145 and 182–183), English meanings that had drifted from their names, and word-by-word tables built by a dictionary rather than by grammar. Every substantive change is listed in Appendix A with its reason. Where two good readings exist, the one this text has always printed is kept unless it is wrong, and the other is recorded in Appendix B.

Numbering. The names fill 182½ ślokas; the second half of śloka 183 (एवं श्रीललितादेव्या नाम्नां साहस्रकं जगुः) closes the hymn. Some names exist only because of Bhāskararāya's division and are kept as he counts them: tat · tvam · ayī (425–427, from तत्त्वमयी), sādhu · ī (711–712, from साध्वी), brahma · jananī (822–823) and dharā · dharasutā (955–956). The nyāsa, dhyāna and colophon are not numbered among the names. No phalaśruti is printed here, because the source does not contain one.

How to read an entry. Each śloka is given in Devanagari and IAST, with its names listed by number. Each name then has: Sandhi viccheda, the sound changes inside the name undone; Samāsa vigraha, the compound type and the traditional analysing sentence (vigraha-vākya), with how its members relate; a word-by-word table with one grammatical unit per row in its underlying form; the complete meaning; and a short note on its traditional significance. These are different things and are kept apart: the table is literal, the meaning follows the grammar, and the significance is interpretation. The hyphens in the IAST are reading aids placed only where the word can be cut without changing a letter. 129 interpretations that are disputed or could not be confirmed are marked Uncertain and listed in Appendix B.

What this is not. It is not a translation of the Saubhāgyabhāskara, and it does not attribute a reading to Bhāskararāya or any other authority unless the attribution is secure. Readers who need the commentary itself should read it; this edition is a careful guide to the words.

Nyāsa न्यासः

अस्य श्रीललितासहस्रनामस्तोत्रमालामन्त्रस्य ।
वशिन्यादिवाग्देवता ऋषयः ।
अनुष्टुप्छन्दः ।
श्रीललितापरमेश्वरी देवता ।
श्रीमद्वाग्भवकूटेति बीजम् ।
मध्यकूटेति शक्तिः ।
शक्तिकूटेति कीलकम् ।
श्रीललितामहात्रिपुरसुन्दरीप्रसादसिद्धिद्वारा चिन्तितफलावाप्त्यर्थे जपे विनियोगः ॥

asya śrīlalitāsahasranāmastotramālāmantrasya |
vaśinyādivāgdevatā ṛṣayaḥ |
anuṣṭupchandaḥ |
śrīlalitāparameśvarī devatā |
śrīmadvāgbhavakūṭeti bījam |
madhyakūṭeti śaktiḥ |
śaktikūṭeti kīlakam |
śrīlalitāmahātripurasundarīprasādasiddhidvārā cintitaphalāvāptyarthe jape viniyogaḥ ||

The ṛṣi, chandas, devatā, bīja, śakti, kīlaka and viniyoga of the hymn, recited before it. This is the nyāsa as the source gives it; the fuller kara- and aṅga-nyāsa used in some traditions is not in the source and is not added.

Dhyāna ślokas ध्यानम्

Dhyāna 1

सिन्दूरारुणविग्रहां त्रिनयनां माणिक्यमौलिस्फुरत् ।
तारानायकशेखरां स्मितमुखीमापीनवक्षोरुहाम् ।
पाणिभ्यामलिपूर्णरत्नचषकं रक्तोत्पलं बिभ्रतीं ।
सौम्यां रत्नघटस्थरक्तचरणां ध्यायेत्परामम्बिकाम् ॥

sindūrāruṇa-vigrahāṃ tri-nayanāṃ māṇikya-mauli-sphurat- |
tārānāyaka-śekharāṃ smita-mukhīm-āpīna-vakṣoruhām |
pāṇibhyām-ali-pūrṇa-ratna-caṣakaṃ raktotpalaṃ bibhratīṃ |
saumyāṃ ratna-ghaṭastha-rakta-caraṇāṃ dhyāyet-parām-ambikām ||

The Divine Mother is to be meditated upon as shining in a vermilion-red body, with three eyes, sporting a crown of rubies studded with the crescent moon, a face all smiles, a splendid bust, one hand holding a jewel-cup brimming with mead, and the other twirling a red lotus.

Dhyāna 2

अरुणां करुणातरङ्गिताक्षीं धृतपाशाङ्कुशपुष्पबाणचापाम् ।
अणिमादिभिरावृतां मयूखैः अहमित्येव विभावये भवानीम् ॥

aruṇāṃ karuṇā-taraṅgitākṣīṃ dhṛta-pāśāṅkuśa-puṣpa-bāṇa-cāpām |
aṇimādibhir-āvṛtāṃ mayūkhaiḥ aham-ity-eva vibhāvaye bhavānīm ||

I meditate on the great Empress. She is red in color, and Her eyes are full of compassion, and holds the noose, the goad, the bow and the flowery arrow in Her hands. She is surrounded on all sides by powers such as Anima for rays and She is the Self within me.

Dhyāna 3

ध्यायेत्पद्मासनस्थां विकसितवदनां पद्मपत्रायताक्षीं ।
हेमाभां पीतवस्त्रां करकलितलसद्धेमपद्मां वराङ्गीम् ।
सर्वालङ्कारयुक्तां सततमभयदां भक्तनम्रां भवानीं ।
श्रीविद्यां शान्तमूर्तिं सकलसुरनुतां सर्वसम्पत्प्रदात्रीम् ॥

dhyāyet-padmāsanasthāṃ vikasita-vadanāṃ padma-patrāyatākṣīṃ |
hemābhāṃ pītavastrāṃ kara-kalita-lasadd-hema-padmāṃ varāṅgīm |
sarvālaṅkāra-yuktāṃ satatam-abhayadāṃ bhakta-namrāṃ bhavānīṃ |
śrī-vidyāṃ śānta-mūrtiṃ sakala-sura-nutāṃ sarva-sampat-pradātrīm ||

The Divine Goddess is to be meditated upon as seated on the lotus with petal eyes. She is golden hued, and has lotus flowers in Her hand. She dispels fear of the devotees who bow before Her. She is the embodiment of peace, knowledge (Sri Vidya), is praised by gods and grants every kind of wealth wished for.

Dhyāna 4

सकुङ्कुमविलेपनामलिकचुम्बिकस्तूरिकां ।
समन्दहसितेक्षणां सशरचापपाशाङ्कुशाम् ।
अशेषजनमोहिनीमरुणमाल्यभूषाम्बरां ।
जपाकुसुमभासुरां जपविधौ स्मरेदम्बिकाम् ॥

sakuṅkuma-vilepanām-alika-cumbi-kastūrikāṃ |
samanda-hasitekṣaṇāṃ saśara-cāpa-pāśāṅkuśām |
aśeṣa-jana-mohinīm-aruṇa-mālya-bhūṣāmbarāṃ |
japā-kusuma-bhāsurāṃ japavidhau smared-ambikām ||

I meditate on the Mother, whose eyes are smiling, who holds the arrow, bow, noose and the goad in Her hand. She is glittering with red garlands and ornaments. She is painted with kumkuma on Her forehead and is red and tender like the japa flower.

Śrī Lalitā Sahasranāma Stotram अथ श्रीललितासहस्रनामस्तोत्रम्

The text for recitation. Numbers in the margin are śloka numbers; the analysis below gives the name numbers.

1

श्रीमाता श्रीमहाराज्ञी श्रीमत्सिंहासनेश्वरी ।
चिदग्निकुण्डसम्भूता देवकार्यसमुद्यता ॥ १ ॥

śrīmātā śrīmahārājñī śrīmatsiṃhāsaneśvarī
cidagnikuṇḍasambhūtā devakāryasamudyatā

2

उद्यद्भानुसहस्राभा चतुर्बाहुसमन्विता ।
रागस्वरूपपाशाढ्या क्रोधाकाराङ्कुशोज्ज्वला ॥ २ ॥

udyadbhānusahasrābhā caturbāhusamanvitā
rāgasvarūpapāśāḍhyā krodhākārāṅkuśojjvalā

3

मनोरूपेक्षुकोदण्डा पञ्चतन्मात्रसायका ।
निजारुणप्रभापूरमज्जद्ब्रह्माण्डमण्डला ॥ ३ ॥

manorūpekṣukodaṇḍā pañcatanmātrasāyakā
nijāruṇaprabhāpūramajjadbrahmāṇḍamaṇḍalā

4

चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसौगन्धिकलसत्कचा ।
कुरुविन्दमणिश्रेणीकनत्कोटीरमण्डिता ॥ ४ ॥

campakāśokapunnāgasaugandhikalasatkacā
kuruvindamaṇiśreṇīkanatkoṭīramaṇḍitā

5

अष्टमीचन्द्रविभ्राजदलिकस्थलशोभिता ।
मुखचन्द्रकलङ्काभमृगनाभिविशेषका ॥ ५ ॥

aṣṭamīcandravibhrājadalikasthalaśobhitā
mukhacandrakalaṅkābhamṛganābhiviśeṣakā

6

वदनस्मरमाङ्गल्यगृहतोरणचिल्लिका ।
वक्त्रलक्ष्मीपरीवाहचलन्मीनाभलोचना ॥ ६ ॥

vadanasmaramāṅgalyagṛhatoraṇacillikā
vaktralakṣmīparīvāhacalanmīnābhalocanā

7

नवचम्पकपुष्पाभनासादण्डविराजिता ।
ताराकान्तितिरस्कारिनासाभरणभासुरा ॥ ७ ॥

navacampakapuṣpābhanāsādaṇḍavirājitā
tārākāntitiraskārināsābharaṇabhāsurā

8

कदम्बमञ्जरीकॢप्तकर्णपूरमनोहरा ।
ताटङ्कयुगलीभूततपनोडुपमण्डला ॥ ८ ॥

kadambamañjarīkḷptakarṇapūramanoharā
tāṭaṅkayugalībhūtatapanoḍupamaṇḍalā

9

पद्मरागशिलादर्शपरिभाविकपोलभूः ।
नवविद्रुमबिम्बश्रीन्यक्कारिरदनच्छदा ॥ ९ ॥

padmarāgaśilādarśaparibhāvikapolabhūḥ
navavidrumabimbaśrīnyakkāriradanacchadā

10

शुद्धविद्याङ्कुराकारद्विजपङ्क्तिद्वयोज्ज्वला ।
कर्पूरवीटिकामोदसमाकर्षिदिगन्तरा ॥ १० ॥

śuddhavidyāṅkurākāradvijapaṅktidvayojjvalā
karpūravīṭikāmodasamākarṣidigantarā

11

निजसल्लापमाधुर्यविनिर्भर्त्सितकच्छपी ।
मन्दस्मितप्रभापूरमज्जत्कामेशमानसा ॥ ११ ॥

nijasallāpamādhuryavinirbhartsitakacchapī
mandasmitaprabhāpūramajjatkāmeśamānasā

12

अनाकलितसादृश्यचिबुकश्रीविराजिता ।
कामेशबद्धमाङ्गल्यसूत्रशोभितकन्धरा ॥ १२ ॥

anākalitasādṛśyacibukaśrīvirājitā
kāmeśabaddhamāṅgalyasūtraśobhitakandharā

13

कनकाङ्गदकेयूरकमनीयभुजान्विता ।
रत्नग्रैवेयचिन्ताकलोलमुक्ताफलान्विता ॥ १३ ॥

kanakāṅgadakeyūrakamanīyabhujānvitā
ratnagraiveyacintākalolamuktāphalānvitā

14

कामेश्वरप्रेमरत्नमणिप्रतिपणस्तनी ।
नाभ्यालवालरोमालिलताफलकुचद्वयी ॥ १४ ॥

kāmeśvarapremaratnamaṇipratipaṇastanī
nābhyālavālaromālilatāphalakucadvayī

15

लक्ष्यरोमलताधारतासमुन्नेयमध्यमा ।
स्तनभारदलन्मध्यपट्टबन्धवलित्रया ॥ १५ ॥

lakṣyaromalatādhāratāsamunneyamadhyamā
stanabhāradalanmadhyapaṭṭabandhavalitrayā

16

अरुणारुणकौसुम्भवस्त्रभास्वत्कटीतटी ।
रत्नकिङ्किणिकारम्यरशनादामभूषिता ॥ १६ ॥

aruṇāruṇakausumbhavastrabhāsvatkaṭītaṭī
ratnakiṅkiṇikāramyaraśanādāmabhūṣitā

17

कामेशज्ञातसौभाग्यमार्दवोरुद्वयान्विता ।
माणिक्यमुकुटाकारजानुद्वयविराजिता ॥ १७ ॥

kāmeśajñātasaubhāgyamārdavorudvayānvitā
māṇikyamukuṭākārajānudvayavirājitā

18

इन्द्रगोपपरिक्षिप्तस्मरतूणाभजङ्घिका ।
गूढगुल्फा कूर्मपृष्ठजयिष्णुप्रपदान्विता ॥ १८ ॥

indragopaparikṣiptasmaratūṇābhajaṅghikā
gūḍhagulphā kūrmapṛṣṭhajayiṣṇuprapadānvitā

19

नखदीधितिसञ्छन्ननमज्जनतमोगुणा ।
पदद्वयप्रभाजालपराकृतसरोरुहा ॥ १९ ॥

nakhadīdhitisañchannanamajjanatamoguṇā
padadvayaprabhājālaparākṛtasaroruhā

20

शिञ्जानमणिमञ्जीरमण्डितश्रीपदाम्बुजा ।
मरालीमन्दगमना महालावण्यशेवधिः ॥ २० ॥

śiñjānamaṇimañjīramaṇḍitaśrīpadāmbujā
marālīmandagamanā mahālāvaṇyaśevadhiḥ

21

सर्वारुणाऽनवद्याङ्गी सर्वाभरणभूषिता ।
शिवकामेश्वराङ्कस्था शिवा स्वाधीनवल्लभा ॥ २१ ॥

sarvāruṇā'navadyāṅgī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā
śivakāmeśvarāṅkasthā śivā svādhīnavallabhā

22

सुमेरुमध्यशृङ्गस्था श्रीमन्नगरनायिका ।
चिन्तामणिगृहान्तस्था पञ्चब्रह्मासनस्थिता ॥ २२ ॥

sumerumadhyaśṛṅgasthā śrīmannagaranāyikā
cintāmaṇigṛhāntasthā pañcabrahmāsanasthitā

23

महापद्माटवीसंस्था कदम्बवनवासिनी ।
सुधासागरमध्यस्था कामाक्षी कामदायिनी ॥ २३ ॥

mahāpadmāṭavīsaṃsthā kadambavanavāsinī
sudhāsāgaramadhyasthā kāmākṣī kāmadāyinī

24

देवर्षिगणसङ्घातस्तूयमानात्मवैभवा ।
भण्डासुरवधोद्युक्तशक्तिसेनासमन्विता ॥ २४ ॥

devarṣigaṇasaṅghātastūyamānātmavaibhavā
bhaṇḍāsuravadhodyuktaśaktisenāsamanvitā

25

सम्पत्करीसमारूढसिन्धुरव्रजसेविता ।
अश्वारूढाधिष्ठिताश्वकोटिकोटिभिरावृता ॥ २५ ॥

sampatkarīsamārūḍhasindhuravrajasevitā
aśvārūḍhādhiṣṭhitāśvakoṭikoṭibhirāvṛtā

26

चक्रराजरथारूढसर्वायुधपरिष्कृता ।
गेयचक्ररथारूढमन्त्रिणीपरिसेविता ॥ २६ ॥

cakrarājarathārūḍhasarvāyudhapariṣkṛtā
geyacakrarathārūḍhamantriṇīparisevitā

27

किरिचक्ररथारूढदण्डनाथापुरस्कृता ।
ज्वालामालिनिकाक्षिप्तवह्निप्राकारमध्यगा ॥ २७ ॥

kiricakrarathārūḍhadaṇḍanāthāpuraskṛtā
jvālāmālinikākṣiptavahniprākāramadhyagā

28

भण्डसैन्यवधोद्युक्तशक्तिविक्रमहर्षिता ।
नित्यापराक्रमाटोपनिरीक्षणसमुत्सुका ॥ २८ ॥

bhaṇḍasainyavadhodyuktaśaktivikramaharṣitā
nityāparākramāṭopanirīkṣaṇasamutsukā

29

भण्डपुत्रवधोद्युक्तबालाविक्रमनन्दिता ।
मन्त्रिण्यम्बाविरचितविषङ्गवधतोषिता ॥ २९ ॥

bhaṇḍaputravadhodyuktabālāvikramananditā
mantriṇyambāviracitaviṣaṅgavadhatoṣitā

30

विशुक्रप्राणहरणवाराहीवीर्यनन्दिता ।
कामेश्वरमुखालोककल्पितश्रीगणेश्वरा ॥ ३० ॥

viśukraprāṇaharaṇavārāhīvīryananditā
kāmeśvaramukhālokakalpitaśrīgaṇeśvarā

31

महागणेशनिर्भिन्नविघ्नयन्त्रप्रहर्षिता ।
भण्डासुरेन्द्रनिर्मुक्तशस्त्रप्रत्यस्त्रवर्षिणी ॥ ३१ ॥

mahāgaṇeśanirbhinnavighnayantrapraharṣitā
bhaṇḍāsurendranirmuktaśastrapratyastravarṣiṇī

32

कराङ्गुलिनखोत्पन्ननारायणदशाकृतिः ।
महापाशुपतास्त्राग्निनिर्दग्धासुरसैनिका ॥ ३२ ॥

karāṅgulinakhotpannanārāyaṇadaśākṛtiḥ
mahāpāśupatāstrāgninirdagdhāsurasainikā

33

कामेश्वरास्त्रनिर्दग्धसभण्डासुरशून्यका ।
ब्रह्मोपेन्द्रमहेन्द्रादिदेवसंस्तुतवैभवा ॥ ३३ ॥

kāmeśvarāstranirdagdhasabhaṇḍāsuraśūnyakā
brahmopendramahendrādidevasaṃstutavaibhavā

34

हरनेत्राग्निसन्दग्धकामसञ्जीवनौषधिः ।
श्रीमद्वाग्भवकूटैकस्वरूपमुखपङ्कजा ॥ ३४ ॥

haranetrāgnisandagdhakāmasañjīvanauṣadhiḥ
śrīmadvāgbhavakūṭaikasvarūpamukhapaṅkajā

35

कण्ठाधःकटिपर्यन्तमध्यकूटस्वरूपिणी ।
शक्तिकूटैकतापन्नकट्यधोभागधारिणी ॥ ३५ ॥

kaṇṭhādhaḥkaṭiparyantamadhyakūṭasvarūpiṇī
śaktikūṭaikatāpannakaṭyadhobhāgadhāriṇī

36

मूलमन्त्रात्मिका मूलकूटत्रयकलेवरा ।
कुलामृतैकरसिका कुलसङ्केतपालिनी ॥ ३६ ॥

mūlamantrātmikā mūlakūṭatrayakalevarā
kulāmṛtaikarasikā kulasaṅketapālinī

37

कुलाङ्गना कुलान्तस्था कौलिनी कुलयोगिनी ।
अकुला समयान्तस्था समयाचारतत्परा ॥ ३७ ॥

kulāṅganā kulāntasthā kaulinī kulayoginī
akulā samayāntasthā samayācāratatparā

38

मूलाधारैकनिलया ब्रह्मग्रन्थिविभेदिनी ।
मणिपूरान्तरुदिता विष्णुग्रन्थिविभेदिनी ॥ ३८ ॥

mūlādhāraikanilayā brahmagranthivibhedinī
maṇipūrāntaruditā viṣṇugranthivibhedinī

39

आज्ञाचक्रान्तरालस्था रुद्रग्रन्थिविभेदिनी ।
सहस्राराम्बुजारूढा सुधासाराभिवर्षिणी ॥ ३९ ॥

ājñācakrāntarālasthā rudragranthivibhedinī
sahasrārāmbujārūḍhā sudhāsārābhivarṣiṇī

40

तडिल्लतासमरुचिः षट्चक्रोपरिसंस्थिता ।
महासक्तिः कुण्डलिनी बिसतन्तुतनीयसी ॥ ४० ॥

taḍillatāsamaruciḥ ṣaṭcakroparisaṃsthitā
mahāsaktiḥ kuṇḍalinī bisatantutanīyasī

41

भवानी भावनागम्या भवारण्यकुठारिका ।
भद्रप्रिया भद्रमूर्तिर्भक्तसौभाग्यदायिनी ॥ ४१ ॥

bhavānī bhāvanāgamyā bhavāraṇyakuṭhārikā
bhadrapriyā bhadramūrtirbhaktasaubhāgyadāyinī

42

भक्तिप्रिया भक्तिगम्या भक्तिवश्या भयापहा ।
शाम्भवी शारदाराध्या शर्वाणी शर्मदायिनी ॥ ४२ ॥

bhaktipriyā bhaktigamyā bhaktivaśyā bhayāpahā
śāmbhavī śāradārādhyā śarvāṇī śarmadāyinī

43

शाङ्करी श्रीकरी साध्वी शरच्चन्द्रनिभानना ।
शातोदरी शान्तिमती निराधारा निरञ्जना ॥ ४३ ॥

śāṅkarī śrīkarī sādhvī śaraccandranibhānanā
śātodarī śāntimatī nirādhārā nirañjanā

44

निर्लेपा निर्मला नित्या निराकारा निराकुला ।
निर्गुणा निष्कला शान्ता निष्कामा निरुपप्लवा ॥ ४४ ॥

nirlepā nirmalā nityā nirākārā nirākulā
nirguṇā niṣkalā śāntā niṣkāmā nirupaplavā

45

नित्यमुक्ता निर्विकारा निष्प्रपञ्चा निराश्रया ।
नित्यशुद्धा नित्यबुद्धा निरवद्या निरन्तरा ॥ ४५ ॥

nityamuktā nirvikārā niṣprapañcā nirāśrayā
nityaśuddhā nityabuddhā niravadyā nirantarā

46

निष्कारणा निष्कलङ्का निरुपाधिर्निरीश्वरा ।
नीरागा रागमथनी निर्मदा मदनाशिनी ॥ ४६ ॥

niṣkāraṇā niṣkalaṅkā nirupādhirnirīśvarā
nīrāgā rāgamathanī nirmadā madanāśinī

47

निश्चिन्ता निरहङ्कारा निर्मोहा मोहनाशिनी ।
निर्ममा ममताहन्त्री निष्पापा पापनाशिनी ॥ ४७ ॥

niścintā nirahaṅkārā nirmohā mohanāśinī
nirmamā mamatāhantrī niṣpāpā pāpanāśinī

48

निष्क्रोधा क्रोधशमनी निर्लोभा लोभनाशिनी ।
निःसंशया संशयघ्नी निर्भवा भवनाशिनी ॥ ४८ ॥

niṣkrodhā krodhaśamanī nirlobhā lobhanāśinī
niḥsaṃśayā saṃśayaghnī nirbhavā bhavanāśinī

49

निर्विकल्पा निराबाधा निर्भेदा भेदनाशिनी ।
निर्नाशा मृत्युमथनी निष्क्रिया निष्परिग्रहा ॥ ४९ ॥

nirvikalpā nirābādhā nirbhedā bhedanāśinī
nirnāśā mṛtyumathanī niṣkriyā niṣparigrahā

50

निस्तुला नीलचिकुरा निरपाया निरत्यया ।
दुर्लभा दुर्गमा दुर्गा दुःखहन्त्री सुखप्रदा ॥ ५० ॥

nistulā nīlacikurā nirapāyā niratyayā
durlabhā durgamā durgā duḥkhahantrī sukhapradā

51

दुष्टदूरा दुराचारशमनी दोषवर्जिता ।
सर्वज्ञा सान्द्रकरुणा समानाधिकवर्जिता ॥ ५१ ॥

duṣṭadūrā durācāraśamanī doṣavarjitā
sarvajñā sāndrakaruṇā samānādhikavarjitā

52

सर्वशक्तिमयी सर्वमङ्गला सद्गतिप्रदा ।
सर्वेश्वरी सर्वमयी सर्वमन्त्रस्वरूपिणी ॥ ५२ ॥

sarvaśaktimayī sarvamaṅgalā sadgatipradā
sarveśvarī sarvamayī sarvamantrasvarūpiṇī

53

सर्वयन्त्रात्मिका सर्वतन्त्ररूपा मनोन्मनी ।
माहेश्वरी महादेवी महालक्ष्मीर्मृडप्रिया ॥ ५३ ॥

sarvayantrātmikā sarvatantrarūpā manonmanī
māheśvarī mahādevī mahālakṣmīrmṛḍapriyā

54

महारूपा महापूज्या महापातकनाशिनी ।
महामाया महासत्त्वा महाशक्तिर्महारतिः ॥ ५४ ॥

mahārūpā mahāpūjyā mahāpātakanāśinī
mahāmāyā mahāsattvā mahāśaktirmahāratiḥ

55

महाभोगा महैश्वर्या महावीर्या महाबला ।
महाबुद्धिर्महासिद्धिर्महायोगेश्वरेश्वरी ॥ ५५ ॥

mahābhogā mahaiśvaryā mahāvīryā mahābalā
mahābuddhirmahāsiddhirmahāyogeśvareśvarī

56

महातन्त्रा महामन्त्रा महायन्त्रा महासना ।
महायागक्रमाराध्या महाभैरवपूजिता ॥ ५६ ॥

mahātantrā mahāmantrā mahāyantrā mahāsanā
mahāyāgakramārādhyā mahābhairavapūjitā

57

महेश्वरमहाकल्पमहाताण्डवसाक्षिणी ।
महाकामेशमहिषी महात्रिपुरसुन्दरी ॥ ५७ ॥

maheśvaramahākalpamahātāṇḍavasākṣiṇī
mahākāmeśamahiṣī mahātripurasundarī

58

चतुःषष्ट्युपचाराढ्या चतुःषष्टिकलामयी ।
महाचतुःषष्टिकोटियोगिनीगणसेविता ॥ ५८ ॥

catuḥṣaṣṭyupacārāḍhyā catuḥṣaṣṭikalāmayī
mahācatuḥṣaṣṭikoṭiyoginīgaṇasevitā

59

मनुविद्या चन्द्रविद्या चन्द्रमण्डलमध्यगा ।
चारुरूपा चारुहासा चारुचन्द्रकलाधरा ॥ ५९ ॥

manuvidyā candravidyā candramaṇḍalamadhyagā
cārurūpā cāruhāsā cārucandrakalādharā

60

चराचरजगन्नाथा चक्रराजनिकेतना ।
पार्वती पद्मनयना पद्मरागसमप्रभा ॥ ६० ॥

carācarajagannāthā cakrarājaniketanā
pārvatī padmanayanā padmarāgasamaprabhā

61

पञ्चप्रेतासनासीना पञ्चब्रह्मस्वरूपिणी ।
चिन्मयी परमानन्दा विज्ञानघनरूपिणी ॥ ६१ ॥

pañcapretāsanāsīnā pañcabrahmasvarūpiṇī
cinmayī paramānandā vijñānaghanarūpiṇī

62

ध्यानध्यातृध्येयरूपा धर्माधर्मविवर्जिता ।
विश्वरूपा जागरिणी स्वपन्ती तैजसात्मिका ॥ ६२ ॥

dhyānadhyātṛdhyeyarūpā dharmādharmavivarjitā
viśvarūpā jāgariṇī svapantī taijasātmikā

63

सुप्ता प्राज्ञात्मिका तुर्या सर्वावस्थाविवर्जिता ।
सृष्टिकर्त्री ब्रह्मरूपा गोप्त्री गोविन्दरूपिणी ॥ ६३ ॥

suptā prājñātmikā turyā sarvāvasthāvivarjitā
sṛṣṭikartrī brahmarūpā goptrī govindarūpiṇī

64

संहारिणी रुद्ररूपा तिरोधानकरीश्वरी ।
सदाशिवाऽनुग्रहदा पञ्चकृत्यपरायणा ॥ ६४ ॥

saṃhāriṇī rudrarūpā tirodhānakarīśvarī
sadāśivā'nugrahadā pañcakṛtyaparāyaṇā

65

भानुमण्डलमध्यस्था भैरवी भगमालिनी ।
पद्मासना भगवती पद्मनाभसहोदरी ॥ ६५ ॥

bhānumaṇḍalamadhyasthā bhairavī bhagamālinī
padmāsanā bhagavatī padmanābhasahodarī

66

उन्मेषनिमिषोत्पन्नविपन्नभुवनावली ।
सहस्रशीर्षवदना सहस्राक्षी सहस्रपात् ॥ ६६ ॥

unmeṣanimiṣotpannavipannabhuvanāvalī
sahasraśīrṣavadanā sahasrākṣī sahasrapāt

67

आब्रह्मकीटजननी वर्णाश्रमविधायिनी ।
निजाज्ञारूपनिगमा पुण्यापुण्यफलप्रदा ॥ ६७ ॥

ābrahmakīṭajananī varṇāśramavidhāyinī
nijājñārūpanigamā puṇyāpuṇyaphalapradā

68

श्रुतिसीमन्तसिन्दूरीकृतपादाब्जधूलिका ।
सकलागमसन्दोहशुक्तिसम्पुटमौक्तिका ॥ ६८ ॥

śrutisīmantasindūrīkṛtapādābjadhūlikā
sakalāgamasandohaśuktisampuṭamauktikā

69

पुरुषार्थप्रदा पूर्णा भोगिनी भुवनेश्वरी ।
अम्बिकाऽनादिनिधना हरिब्रह्मेन्द्रसेविता ॥ ६९ ॥

puruṣārthapradā pūrṇā bhoginī bhuvaneśvarī
ambikā'nādinidhanā haribrahmendrasevitā

70

नारायणी नादरूपा नामरूपविवर्जिता ।
ह्रीङ्कारी ह्रीमती हृद्या हेयोपादेयवर्जिता ॥ ७० ॥

nārāyaṇī nādarūpā nāmarūpavivarjitā
hrīṅkārī hrīmatī hṛdyā heyopādeyavarjitā

71

राजराजार्चिता राज्ञी रम्या राजीवलोचना ।
रञ्जनी रमणी रस्या रणत्किङ्किणिमेखला ॥ ७१ ॥

rājarājārcitā rājñī ramyā rājīvalocanā
rañjanī ramaṇī rasyā raṇatkiṅkiṇimekhalā

72

रमा राकेन्दुवदना रतिरूपा रतिप्रिया ।
रक्षाकरी राक्षसघ्नी रामा रमणलम्पटा ॥ ७२ ॥

ramā rākenduvadanā ratirūpā ratipriyā
rakṣākarī rākṣasaghnī rāmā ramaṇalampaṭā

73

काम्या कामकलारूपा कदम्बकुसुमप्रिया ।
कल्याणी जगतीकन्दा करुणारससागरा ॥ ७३ ॥

kāmyā kāmakalārūpā kadambakusumapriyā
kalyāṇī jagatīkandā karuṇārasasāgarā

74

कलावती कलालापा कान्ता कादम्बरीप्रिया ।
वरदा वामनयना वारुणीमदविह्वला ॥ ७४ ॥

kalāvatī kalālāpā kāntā kādambarīpriyā
varadā vāmanayanā vāruṇīmadavihvalā

75

विश्वाधिका वेदवेद्या विन्ध्याचलनिवासिनी ।
विधात्री वेदजननी विष्णुमाया विलासिनी ॥ ७५ ॥

viśvādhikā vedavedyā vindhyācalanivāsinī
vidhātrī vedajananī viṣṇumāyā vilāsinī

76

क्षेत्रस्वरूपा क्षेत्रेशी क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञपालिनी ।
क्षयवृद्धिविनिर्मुक्ता क्षेत्रपालसमर्चिता ॥ ७६ ॥

kṣetrasvarūpā kṣetreśī kṣetrakṣetrajñapālinī
kṣayavṛddhivinirmuktā kṣetrapālasamarcitā

77

विजया विमला वन्द्या वन्दारुजनवत्सला ।
वाग्वादिनी वामकेशी वह्निमण्डलवासिनी ॥ ७७ ॥

vijayā vimalā vandyā vandārujanavatsalā
vāgvādinī vāmakeśī vahnimaṇḍalavāsinī

78

भक्तिमत्कल्पलतिका पशुपाशविमोचिनी ।
संहृताशेषपाषण्डा सदाचारप्रवर्तिका ॥ ७८ ॥

bhaktimatkalpalatikā paśupāśavimocinī
saṃhṛtāśeṣapāṣaṇḍā sadācārapravartikā

79

तापत्रयाग्निसन्तप्तसमाह्लादनचन्द्रिका ।
तरुणी तापसाराध्या तनुमध्या तमोऽपहा ॥ ७९ ॥

tāpatrayāgnisantaptasamāhlādanacandrikā
taruṇī tāpasārādhyā tanumadhyā tamo'pahā

80

चितिस्तत्पदलक्ष्यार्था चिदेकरसरूपिणी ।
स्वात्मानन्दलवीभूतब्रह्माद्यानन्दसन्ततिः ॥ ८० ॥

citistatpadalakṣyārthā cidekarasarūpiṇī
svātmānandalavībhūtabrahmādyānandasantatiḥ

81

परा प्रत्यक्चितीरूपा पश्यन्ती परदेवता ।
मध्यमा वैखरीरूपा भक्तमानसहंसिका ॥ ८१ ॥

parā pratyakcitīrūpā paśyantī paradevatā
madhyamā vaikharīrūpā bhaktamānasahaṃsikā

82

कामेश्वरप्राणनाडी कृतज्ञा कामपूजिता ।
शृङ्गाररससम्पूर्णा जया जालन्धरस्थिता ॥ ८२ ॥

kāmeśvaraprāṇanāḍī kṛtajñā kāmapūjitā
śṛṅgārarasasampūrṇā jayā jālandharasthitā

83

ओड्याणपीठनिलया बिन्दुमण्डलवासिनी ।
रहोयागक्रमाराध्या रहस्तर्पणतर्पिता ॥ ८३ ॥

oḍyāṇapīṭhanilayā bindumaṇḍalavāsinī
rahoyāgakramārādhyā rahastarpaṇatarpitā

84

सद्यःप्रसादिनी विश्वसाक्षिणी साक्षिवर्जिता ।
षडङ्गदेवतायुक्ता षाड्गुण्यपरिपूरिता ॥ ८४ ॥

sadyaḥprasādinī viśvasākṣiṇī sākṣivarjitā
ṣaḍaṅgadevatāyuktā ṣāḍguṇyaparipūritā

85

नित्यक्लिन्ना निरुपमा निर्वाणसुखदायिनी ।
नित्याषोडशिकारूपा श्रीकण्ठार्धशरीरिणी ॥ ८५ ॥

nityaklinnā nirupamā nirvāṇasukhadāyinī
nityāṣoḍaśikārūpā śrīkaṇṭhārdhaśarīriṇī

86

प्रभावती प्रभारूपा प्रसिद्धा परमेश्वरी ।
मूलप्रकृतिरव्यक्ता व्यक्ताव्यक्तस्वरूपिणी ॥ ८६ ॥

prabhāvatī prabhārūpā prasiddhā parameśvarī
mūlaprakṛtiravyaktā vyaktāvyaktasvarūpiṇī

87

व्यापिनी विविधाकारा विद्याऽविद्यास्वरूपिणी ।
महाकामेशनयनकुमुदाह्लादकौमुदी ॥ ८७ ॥

vyāpinī vividhākārā vidyā'vidyāsvarūpiṇī
mahākāmeśanayanakumudāhlādakaumudī

88

भक्तहार्दतमोभेदभानुमद्भानुसन्ततिः ।
शिवदूती शिवाराध्या शिवमूर्तिः शिवङ्करी ॥ ८८ ॥

bhaktahārdatamobhedabhānumadbhānusantatiḥ
śivadūtī śivārādhyā śivamūrtiḥ śivaṅkarī

89

शिवप्रिया शिवपरा शिष्टेष्टा शिष्टपूजिता ।
अप्रमेया स्वप्रकाशा मनोवाचामगोचरा ॥ ८९ ॥

śivapriyā śivaparā śiṣṭeṣṭā śiṣṭapūjitā
aprameyā svaprakāśā manovācāmagocarā

90

चिच्छक्तिश् चेतनारूपा जडशक्तिर्जडात्मिका ।
गायत्री व्याहृतिः सन्ध्या द्विजवृन्दनिषेविता ॥ ९० ॥

cicchaktiś cetanārūpā jaḍaśaktirjaḍātmikā
gāyatrī vyāhṛtiḥ sandhyā dvijavṛndaniṣevitā

91

तत्त्वासना तत्त्वमयी पञ्चकोशान्तरस्थिता ।
निःसीममहिमा नित्ययौवना मदशालिनी ॥ ९१ ॥

tattvāsanā tattvamayī pañcakośāntarasthitā
niḥsīmamahimā nityayauvanā madaśālinī

92

मदघूर्णितरक्ताक्षी मदपाटलगण्डभूः ।
चन्दनद्रवदिग्धाङ्गी चाम्पेयकुसुमप्रिया ॥ ९२ ॥

madaghūrṇitaraktākṣī madapāṭalagaṇḍabhūḥ
candanadravadigdhāṅgī cāmpeyakusumapriyā

93

कुशला कोमलाकारा कुरुकुल्ला कुलेश्वरी ।
कुलकुण्डालया कौलमार्गतत्परसेविता ॥ ९३ ॥

kuśalā komalākārā kurukullā kuleśvarī
kulakuṇḍālayā kaulamārgatatparasevitā

94

कुमारगणनाथाम्बा तुष्टिः पुष्टिर्मतिर्धृतिः ।
शान्तिः स्वस्तिमती कान्तिर्नन्दिनी विघ्ननाशिनी ॥ ९४ ॥

kumāragaṇanāthāmbā tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirmatirdhṛtiḥ
śāntiḥ svastimatī kāntirnandinī vighnanāśinī

95

तेजोवती त्रिनयना लोलाक्षीकामरूपिणी ।
मालिनी हंसिनी माता मलयाचलवासिनी ॥ ९५ ॥

tejovatī trinayanā lolākṣīkāmarūpiṇī
mālinī haṃsinī mātā malayācalavāsinī

96

सुमुखी नलिनी सुभ्रूः शोभना सुरनायिका ।
कालकण्ठी कान्तिमती क्षोभिणी सूक्ष्मरूपिणी ॥ ९६ ॥

sumukhī nalinī subhrūḥ śobhanā suranāyikā
kālakaṇṭhī kāntimatī kṣobhiṇī sūkṣmarūpiṇī

97

वज्रेश्वरी वामदेवी वयोऽवस्थाविवर्जिता ।
सिद्धेश्वरी सिद्धविद्या सिद्धमाता यशस्विनी ॥ ९७ ॥

vajreśvarī vāmadevī vayo'vasthāvivarjitā
siddheśvarī siddhavidyā siddhamātā yaśasvinī

98

विशुद्धिचक्रनिलयाऽऽरक्तवर्णा त्रिलोचना ।
खट्वाङ्गादिप्रहरणा वदनैकसमन्विता ॥ ९८ ॥

viśuddhicakranilayā''raktavarṇā trilocanā
khaṭvāṅgādipraharaṇā vadanaikasamanvitā

99

पायसान्नप्रिया त्वक्स्था पशुलोकभयङ्करी ।
अमृतादिमहाशक्तिसंवृता डाकिनीश्वरी ॥ ९९ ॥

pāyasānnapriyā tvaksthā paśulokabhayaṅkarī
amṛtādimahāśaktisaṃvṛtā ḍākinīśvarī

100

अनाहताब्जनिलया श्यामाभा वदनद्वया ।
दंष्ट्रोज्ज्वलाऽक्षमालादिधरा रुधिरसंस्थिता ॥ १०० ॥

anāhatābjanilayā śyāmābhā vadanadvayā
daṃṣṭrojjvalā'kṣamālādidharā rudhirasaṃsthitā

101

कालरात्र्यादिशक्त्यौघवृता स्निग्धौदनप्रिया ।
महावीरेन्द्रवरदा राकिण्यम्बास्वरूपिणी ॥ १०१ ॥

kālarātryādiśaktyaughavṛtā snigdhaudanapriyā
mahāvīrendravaradā rākiṇyambāsvarūpiṇī

102

मणिपूराब्जनिलया वदनत्रयसंयुता ।
वज्रादिकायुधोपेता डामर्यादिभिरावृता ॥ १०२ ॥

maṇipūrābjanilayā vadanatrayasaṃyutā
vajrādikāyudhopetā ḍāmaryādibhirāvṛtā

103

रक्तवर्णा मांसनिष्ठा गुडान्नप्रीतमानसा ।
समस्तभक्तसुखदा लाकिन्यम्बास्वरूपिणी ॥ १०३ ॥

raktavarṇā māṃsaniṣṭhā guḍānnaprītamānasā
samastabhaktasukhadā lākinyambāsvarūpiṇī

104

स्वाधिष्ठानाम्बुजगता चतुर्वक्त्रमनोहरा ।
शूलाद्यायुधसम्पन्ना पीतवर्णाऽतिगर्विता ॥ १०४ ॥

svādhiṣṭhānāmbujagatā caturvaktramanoharā
śūlādyāyudhasampannā pītavarṇā'tigarvitā

105

मेदोनिष्ठा मधुप्रीता बन्धिन्यादिसमन्विता ।
दध्यन्नासक्तहृदया काकिनीरूपधारिणी ॥ १०५ ॥

medoniṣṭhā madhuprītā bandhinyādisamanvitā
dadhyannāsaktahṛdayā kākinīrūpadhāriṇī

106

मूलाधाराम्बुजारूढा पञ्चवक्त्राऽस्थिसंस्थिता ।
अङ्कुशादिप्रहरणा वरदादिनिषेविता ॥ १०६ ॥

mūlādhārāmbujārūḍhā pañcavaktrā'sthisaṃsthitā
aṅkuśādipraharaṇā varadādiniṣevitā

107

मुद्गौदनासक्तचित्ता साकिन्यम्बास्वरूपिणी ।
आज्ञाचक्राब्जनिलया शुक्लवर्णा षडानना ॥ १०७ ॥

mudgaudanāsaktacittā sākinyambāsvarūpiṇī
ājñācakrābjanilayā śuklavarṇā ṣaḍānanā

108

मज्जासंस्था हंसवतीमुख्यशक्तिसमन्विता ।
हरिद्रान्नैकरसिका हाकिनीरूपधारिणी ॥ १०८ ॥

majjāsaṃsthā haṃsavatīmukhyaśaktisamanvitā
haridrānnaikarasikā hākinīrūpadhāriṇī

109

सहस्रदलपद्मस्था सर्ववर्णोपशोभिता ।
सर्वायुधधरा शुक्लसंस्थिता सर्वतोमुखी ॥ १०९ ॥

sahasradalapadmasthā sarvavarṇopaśobhitā
sarvāyudhadharā śuklasaṃsthitā sarvatomukhī

110

सर्वौदनप्रीतचित्ता याकिन्यम्बास्वरूपिणी ।
स्वाहा स्वधाऽमतिर्मेधा श्रुतिः स्मृतिरनुत्तमा ॥ ११० ॥

sarvaudanaprītacittā yākinyambāsvarūpiṇī
svāhā svadhā'matirmedhā śrutiḥ smṛtiranuttamā

111

पुण्यकीर्तिः पुण्यलभ्या पुण्यश्रवणकीर्तना ।
पुलोमजार्चिता बन्धमोचनी बन्धुरालका ॥ १११ ॥

puṇyakīrtiḥ puṇyalabhyā puṇyaśravaṇakīrtanā
pulomajārcitā bandhamocanī bandhurālakā

112

विमर्शरूपिणी विद्या वियदादिजगत्प्रसूः ।
सर्वव्याधिप्रशमनी सर्वमृत्युनिवारिणी ॥ ११२ ॥

vimarśarūpiṇī vidyā viyadādijagatprasūḥ
sarvavyādhipraśamanī sarvamṛtyunivāriṇī

113

अग्रगण्याऽचिन्त्यरूपा कलिकल्मषनाशिनी ।
कात्यायनी कालहन्त्री कमलाक्षनिषेविता ॥ ११३ ॥

agragaṇyā'cintyarūpā kalikalmaṣanāśinī
kātyāyanī kālahantrī kamalākṣaniṣevitā

114

ताम्बूलपूरितमुखी दाडिमीकुसुमप्रभा ।
मृगाक्षी मोहिनी मुख्या मृडानी मित्ररूपिणी ॥ ११४ ॥

tāmbūlapūritamukhī dāḍimīkusumaprabhā
mṛgākṣī mohinī mukhyā mṛḍānī mitrarūpiṇī

115

नित्यतृप्ता भक्तनिधिर्नियन्त्री निखिलेश्वरी ।
मैत्र्यादिवासनालभ्या महाप्रलयसाक्षिणी ॥ ११५ ॥

nityatṛptā bhaktanidhirniyantrī nikhileśvarī
maitryādivāsanālabhyā mahāpralayasākṣiṇī

116

परा शक्तिः परा निष्ठा प्रज्ञानघनरूपिणी ।
माध्वीपानालसा मत्ता मातृकावर्णरूपिणी ॥ ११६ ॥

parā śaktiḥ parā niṣṭhā prajñānaghanarūpiṇī
mādhvīpānālasā mattā mātṛkāvarṇarūpiṇī

117

महाकैलासनिलया मृणालमृदुदोर्लता ।
महनीया दयामूर्तिर्महासाम्राज्यशालिनी ॥ ११७ ॥

mahākailāsanilayā mṛṇālamṛdudorlatā
mahanīyā dayāmūrtirmahāsāmrājyaśālinī

118

आत्मविद्या महाविद्या श्रीविद्या कामसेविता ।
श्रीषोडशाक्षरीविद्या त्रिकूटा कामकोटिका ॥ ११८ ॥

ātmavidyā mahāvidyā śrīvidyā kāmasevitā
śrīṣoḍaśākṣarīvidyā trikūṭā kāmakoṭikā

119

कटाक्षकिङ्करीभूतकमलाकोटिसेविता ।
शिरःस्थिता चन्द्रनिभा भालस्थेन्द्रधनुःप्रभा ॥ ११९ ॥

kaṭākṣakiṅkarībhūtakamalākoṭisevitā
śiraḥsthitā candranibhā bhālasthendradhanuḥprabhā

120

हृदयस्था रविप्रख्या त्रिकोणान्तरदीपिका ।
दाक्षायणी दैत्यहन्त्री दक्षयज्ञविनाशिनी ॥ १२० ॥

hṛdayasthā raviprakhyā trikoṇāntaradīpikā
dākṣāyaṇī daityahantrī dakṣayajñavināśinī

121

दरान्दोलितदीर्घाक्षी दरहासोज्ज्वलन्मुखी ।
गुरुमूर्तिर्गुणनिधिर्गोमाता गुहजन्मभूः ॥ १२१ ॥

darāndolitadīrghākṣī darahāsojjvalanmukhī
gurumūrtirguṇanidhirgomātā guhajanmabhūḥ

122

देवेशी दण्डनीतिस्था दहराकाशरूपिणी ।
प्रतिपन्मुख्यराकान्ततिथिमण्डलपूजिता ॥ १२२ ॥

deveśī daṇḍanītisthā daharākāśarūpiṇī
pratipanmukhyarākāntatithimaṇḍalapūjitā

123

कलात्मिका कलानाथा काव्यालापविनोदिनी ।
सचामररमावाणीसव्यदक्षिणसेविता ॥ १२३ ॥

kalātmikā kalānāthā kāvyālāpavinodinī
sacāmararamāvāṇīsavyadakṣiṇasevitā

124

आदिशक्तिरमेयाऽऽत्मा परमा पावनाकृतिः ।
अनेककोटिब्रह्माण्डजननी दिव्यविग्रहा ॥ १२४ ॥

ādiśaktirameyā''tmā paramā pāvanākṛtiḥ
anekakoṭibrahmāṇḍajananī divyavigrahā

125

क्लीङ्कारी केवला गुह्या कैवल्यपददायिनी ।
त्रिपुरा त्रिजगद्वन्द्या त्रिमूर्तिस्त्रिदशेश्वरी ॥ १२५ ॥

klīṅkārī kevalā guhyā kaivalyapadadāyinī
tripurā trijagadvandyā trimūrtistridaśeśvarī

126

त्र्यक्षरी दिव्यगन्धाढ्या सिन्दूरतिलकाञ्चिता ।
उमा शैलेन्द्रतनया गौरी गन्धर्वसेविता ॥ १२६ ॥

tryakṣarī divyagandhāḍhyā sindūratilakāñcitā
umā śailendratanayā gaurī gandharvasevitā

127

विश्वगर्भा स्वर्णगर्भाऽवरदा वागधीश्वरी ।
ध्यानगम्याऽपरिच्छेद्या ज्ञानदा ज्ञानविग्रहा ॥ १२७ ॥

viśvagarbhā svarṇagarbhā'varadā vāgadhīśvarī
dhyānagamyā'paricchedyā jñānadā jñānavigrahā

128

सर्ववेदान्तसंवेद्या सत्यानन्दस्वरूपिणी ।
लोपामुद्रार्चिता लीलाकॢप्तब्रह्माण्डमण्डला ॥ १२८ ॥

sarvavedāntasaṃvedyā satyānandasvarūpiṇī
lopāmudrārcitā līlākḷptabrahmāṇḍamaṇḍalā

129

अदृश्या दृश्यरहिता विज्ञात्री वेद्यवर्जिता ।
योगिनी योगदा योग्या योगानन्दा युगन्धरा ॥ १२९ ॥

adṛśyā dṛśyarahitā vijñātrī vedyavarjitā
yoginī yogadā yogyā yogānandā yugandharā

130

इच्छाशक्तिज्ञानशक्तिक्रियाशक्तिस्वरूपिणी ।
सर्वाधारा सुप्रतिष्ठा सदसद्रूपधारिणी ॥ १३० ॥

icchāśaktijñānaśaktikriyāśaktisvarūpiṇī
sarvādhārā supratiṣṭhā sadasadrūpadhāriṇī

131

अष्टमूर्तिरजाजैत्री लोकयात्राविधायिनी ।
एकाकिनी भूमरूपा निर्द्वैता द्वैतवर्जिता ॥ १३१ ॥

aṣṭamūrtirajājaitrī lokayātrāvidhāyinī
ekākinī bhūmarūpā nirdvaitā dvaitavarjitā

132

अन्नदा वसुदा वृद्धा ब्रह्मात्मैक्यस्वरूपिणी ।
बृहती ब्राह्मणी ब्राह्मी ब्रह्मानन्दा बलिप्रिया ॥ १३२ ॥

annadā vasudā vṛddhā brahmātmaikyasvarūpiṇī
bṛhatī brāhmaṇī brāhmī brahmānandā balipriyā

133

भाषारूपा बृहत्सेना भावाभावविवर्जिता ।
सुखाराध्या शुभकरी शोभना सुलभा गतिः ॥ १३३ ॥

bhāṣārūpā bṛhatsenā bhāvābhāvavivarjitā
sukhārādhyā śubhakarī śobhanā sulabhā gatiḥ

134

राजराजेश्वरी राज्यदायिनी राज्यवल्लभा ।
राजत्कृपा राजपीठनिवेशितनिजाश्रिता ॥ १३४ ॥

rājarājeśvarī rājyadāyinī rājyavallabhā
rājatkṛpā rājapīṭhaniveśitanijāśritā

135

राज्यलक्ष्मीः कोशनाथा चतुरङ्गबलेश्वरी ।
साम्राज्यदायिनी सत्यसन्धा सागरमेखला ॥ १३५ ॥

rājyalakṣmīḥ kośanāthā caturaṅgabaleśvarī
sāmrājyadāyinī satyasandhā sāgaramekhalā

136

दीक्षिता दैत्यशमनी सर्वलोकवशङ्करी ।
सर्वार्थदात्री सावित्री सच्चिदानन्दरूपिणी ॥ १३६ ॥

dīkṣitā daityaśamanī sarvalokavaśaṅkarī
sarvārthadātrī sāvitrī saccidānandarūpiṇī

137

देशकालापरिच्छिन्ना सर्वगा सर्वमोहिनी ।
सरस्वती शास्त्रमयी गुहाम्बा गुह्यरूपिणी ॥ १३७ ॥

deśakālāparicchinnā sarvagā sarvamohinī
sarasvatī śāstramayī guhāmbā guhyarūpiṇī

138

सर्वोपाधिविनिर्मुक्ता सदाशिवपतिव्रता ।
सम्प्रदायेश्वरी साध्वी गुरुमण्डलरूपिणी ॥ १३८ ॥

sarvopādhivinirmuktā sadāśivapativratā
sampradāyeśvarī sādhvī gurumaṇḍalarūpiṇī

139

कुलोत्तीर्णा भगाराध्या माया मधुमती मही ।
गणाम्बा गुह्यकाराध्या कोमलाङ्गी गुरुप्रिया ॥ १३९ ॥

kulottīrṇā bhagārādhyā māyā madhumatī mahī
gaṇāmbā guhyakārādhyā komalāṅgī gurupriyā

140

स्वतन्त्रा सर्वतन्त्रेशी दक्षिणामूर्तिरूपिणी ।
सनकादिसमाराध्या शिवज्ञानप्रदायिनी ॥ १४० ॥

svatantrā sarvatantreśī dakṣiṇāmūrtirūpiṇī
sanakādisamārādhyā śivajñānapradāyinī

141

चित्कलाऽऽनन्दकलिका प्रेमरूपा प्रियङ्करी ।
नामपारायणप्रीता नन्दिविद्या नटेश्वरी ॥ १४१ ॥

citkalā''nandakalikā premarūpā priyaṅkarī
nāmapārāyaṇaprītā nandividyā naṭeśvarī

142

मिथ्याजगदधिष्ठाना मुक्तिदा मुक्तिरूपिणी ।
लास्यप्रिया लयकरी लज्जा रम्भादिवन्दिता ॥ १४२ ॥

mithyājagadadhiṣṭhānā muktidā muktirūpiṇī
lāsyapriyā layakarī lajjā rambhādivanditā

143

भवदावसुधावृष्टिः पापारण्यदवानला ।
दौर्भाग्यतूलवातूला जराध्वान्तरविप्रभा ॥ १४३ ॥

bhavadāvasudhāvṛṣṭiḥ pāpāraṇyadavānalā
daurbhāgyatūlavātūlā jarādhvāntaraviprabhā

144

भाग्याब्धिचन्द्रिका भक्तचित्तकेकिघनाघना ।
रोगपर्वतदम्भोलिर्मृत्युदारुकुठारिका ॥ १४४ ॥

bhāgyābdhicandrikā bhaktacittakekighanāghanā
rogaparvatadambholirmṛtyudārukuṭhārikā

145

महेश्वरी महाकाली महाग्रासा महाशना ।
अपर्णा चण्डिका चण्डमुण्डासुरनिषूदिनी ॥ १४५ ॥

maheśvarī mahākālī mahāgrāsā mahāśanā
aparṇā caṇḍikā caṇḍamuṇḍāsuraniṣūdinī

146

क्षराक्षरात्मिका सर्वलोकेशी विश्वधारिणी ।
त्रिवर्गदात्री सुभगा त्र्यम्बका त्रिगुणात्मिका ॥ १४६ ॥

kṣarākṣarātmikā sarvalokeśī viśvadhāriṇī
trivargadātrī subhagā tryambakā triguṇātmikā

147

स्वर्गापवर्गदा शुद्धा जपापुष्पनिभाकृतिः ।
ओजोवती द्युतिधरा यज्ञरूपा प्रियव्रता ॥ १४७ ॥

svargāpavargadā śuddhā japāpuṣpanibhākṛtiḥ
ojovatī dyutidharā yajñarūpā priyavratā

148

दुराराध्या दुराधर्षा पाटलीकुसुमप्रिया ।
महती मेरुनिलया मन्दारकुसुमप्रिया ॥ १४८ ॥

durārādhyā durādharṣā pāṭalīkusumapriyā
mahatī merunilayā mandārakusumapriyā

149

वीराराध्या विराड्रूपा विरजा विश्वतोमुखी ।
प्रत्यग्रूपा पराकाशा प्राणदा प्राणरूपिणी ॥ १४९ ॥

vīrārādhyā virāḍrūpā virajā viśvatomukhī
pratyagrūpā parākāśā prāṇadā prāṇarūpiṇī

150

मार्ताण्डभैरवाराध्या मन्त्रिणीन्यस्तराज्यधूः ।
त्रिपुरेशी जयत्सेना निस्त्रैगुण्या परापरा ॥ १५० ॥

mārtāṇḍabhairavārādhyā mantriṇīnyastarājyadhūḥ
tripureśī jayatsenā nistraiguṇyā parāparā

151

सत्यज्ञानानन्दरूपा सामरस्यपरायणा ।
कपर्दिनी कलामाला कामधुक् कामरूपिणी ॥ १५१ ॥

satyajñānānandarūpā sāmarasyaparāyaṇā
kapardinī kalāmālā kāmadhuk kāmarūpiṇī

152

कलानिधिः काव्यकला रसज्ञा रसशेवधिः ।
पुष्टा पुरातना पूज्या पुष्करा पुष्करेक्षणा ॥ १५२ ॥

kalānidhiḥ kāvyakalā rasajñā rasaśevadhiḥ
puṣṭā purātanā pūjyā puṣkarā puṣkarekṣaṇā

153

परञ्ज्योतिः परन्धाम परमाणुः परात्परा ।
पाशहस्ता पाशहन्त्री परमन्त्रविभेदिनी ॥ १५३ ॥

parañjyotiḥ parandhāma paramāṇuḥ parātparā
pāśahastā pāśahantrī paramantravibhedinī

154

मूर्ताऽमूर्ताऽनित्यतृप्ता मुनिमानसहंसिका ।
सत्यव्रता सत्यरूपा सर्वान्तर्यामिनी सती ॥ १५४ ॥

mūrtā'mūrtā'nityatṛptā munimānasahaṃsikā
satyavratā satyarūpā sarvāntaryāminī satī

155

ब्रह्माणी ब्रह्मजननी बहुरूपा बुधार्चिता ।
प्रसवित्री प्रचण्डाऽऽज्ञा प्रतिष्ठा प्रकटाकृतिः ॥ १५५ ॥

brahmāṇī brahmajananī bahurūpā budhārcitā
prasavitrī pracaṇḍā''jñā pratiṣṭhā prakaṭākṛtiḥ

156

प्राणेश्वरी प्राणदात्री पञ्चाशत्पीठरूपिणी ।
विशृङ्खला विविक्तस्था वीरमाता वियत्प्रसूः ॥ १५६ ॥

prāṇeśvarī prāṇadātrī pañcāśatpīṭharūpiṇī
viśṛṅkhalā viviktasthā vīramātā viyatprasūḥ

157

मुकुन्दा मुक्तिनिलया मूलविग्रहरूपिणी ।
भावज्ञा भवरोगघ्नी भवचक्रप्रवर्तिनी ॥ १५७ ॥

mukundā muktinilayā mūlavigraharūpiṇī
bhāvajñā bhavarogaghnī bhavacakrapravartinī

158

छन्दःसारा शास्त्रसारा मन्त्रसारा तलोदरी ।
उदारकीर्तिरुद्दामवैभवा वर्णरूपिणी ॥ १५८ ॥

chandaḥsārā śāstrasārā mantrasārā talodarī
udārakīrtiruddāmavaibhavā varṇarūpiṇī

159

जन्ममृत्युजरातप्तजनविश्रान्तिदायिनी ।
सर्वोपनिषदुद्घुष्टा शान्त्यतीतकलात्मिका ॥ १५९ ॥

janmamṛtyujarātaptajanaviśrāntidāyinī
sarvopaniṣadudghuṣṭā śāntyatītakalātmikā

160

गम्भीरा गगनान्तस्था गर्विता गानलोलुपा ।
कल्पनारहिता काष्ठाऽकान्ता कान्तार्धविग्रहा ॥ १६० ॥

gambhīrā gaganāntasthā garvitā gānalolupā
kalpanārahitā kāṣṭhā'kāntā kāntārdhavigrahā

161

कार्यकारणनिर्मुक्ता कामकेलितरङ्गिता ।
कनत्कनकताटङ्का लीलाविग्रहधारिणी ॥ १६१ ॥

kāryakāraṇanirmuktā kāmakelitaraṅgitā
kanatkanakatāṭaṅkā līlāvigrahadhāriṇī

162

अजा क्षयविनिर्मुक्ता मुग्धा क्षिप्रप्रसादिनी ।
अन्तर्मुखसमाराध्या बहिर्मुखसुदुर्लभा ॥ १६२ ॥

ajā kṣayavinirmuktā mugdhā kṣipraprasādinī
antarmukhasamārādhyā bahirmukhasudurlabhā

163

त्रयी त्रिवर्गनिलया त्रिस्था त्रिपुरमालिनी ।
निरामया निरालम्बा स्वात्मारामा सुधासृतिः ॥ १६३ ॥

trayī trivarganilayā tristhā tripuramālinī
nirāmayā nirālambā svātmārāmā sudhāsṛtiḥ

164

संसारपङ्कनिर्मग्नसमुद्धरणपण्डिता ।
यज्ञप्रिया यज्ञकर्त्री यजमानस्वरूपिणी ॥ १६४ ॥

saṃsārapaṅkanirmagnasamuddharaṇapaṇḍitā
yajñapriyā yajñakartrī yajamānasvarūpiṇī

165

धर्माधारा धनाध्यक्षा धनधान्यविवर्धिनी ।
विप्रप्रिया विप्ररूपा विश्वभ्रमणकारिणी ॥ १६५ ॥

dharmādhārā dhanādhyakṣā dhanadhānyavivardhinī
viprapriyā viprarūpā viśvabhramaṇakāriṇī

166

विश्वग्रासा विद्रुमाभा वैष्णवी विष्णुरूपिणी ।
अयोनिर्योनिनिलया कूटस्था कुलरूपिणी ॥ १६६ ॥

viśvagrāsā vidrumābhā vaiṣṇavī viṣṇurūpiṇī
ayoniryoninilayā kūṭasthā kularūpiṇī

167

वीरगोष्ठीप्रिया वीरा नैष्कर्म्या नादरूपिणी ।
विज्ञानकलना कल्या विदग्धा बैन्दवासना ॥ १६७ ॥

vīragoṣṭhīpriyā vīrā naiṣkarmyā nādarūpiṇī
vijñānakalanā kalyā vidagdhā baindavāsanā

168

तत्त्वाधिका तत्त्वमयी तत्त्वमर्थस्वरूपिणी ।
सामगानप्रिया सौम्या सदाशिवकुटुम्बिनी ॥ १६८ ॥

tattvādhikā tattvamayī tattvamarthasvarūpiṇī
sāmagānapriyā saumyā sadāśivakuṭumbinī

169

सव्यापसव्यमार्गस्था सर्वापद्विनिवारिणी ।
स्वस्था स्वभावमधुरा धीरा धीरसमर्चिता ॥ १६९ ॥

savyāpasavyamārgasthā sarvāpadvinivāriṇī
svasthā svabhāvamadhurā dhīrā dhīrasamarcitā

170

चैतन्यार्घ्यसमाराध्या चैतन्यकुसुमप्रिया ।
सदोदिता सदातुष्टा तरुणादित्यपाटला ॥ १७० ॥

caitanyārghyasamārādhyā caitanyakusumapriyā
sadoditā sadātuṣṭā taruṇādityapāṭalā

171

दक्षिणादक्षिणाराध्या दरस्मेरमुखाम्बुजा ।
कौलिनीकेवलाऽनर्घ्यकैवल्यपददायिनी ॥ १७१ ॥

dakṣiṇādakṣiṇārādhyā darasmeramukhāmbujā
kaulinīkevalā'narghyakaivalyapadadāyinī

172

स्तोत्रप्रिया स्तुतिमती श्रुतिसंस्तुतवैभवा ।
मनस्विनी मानवती महेशी मङ्गलाकृतिः ॥ १७२ ॥

stotrapriyā stutimatī śrutisaṃstutavaibhavā
manasvinī mānavatī maheśī maṅgalākṛtiḥ

173

विश्वमाता जगद्धात्री विशालाक्षी विरागिणी ।
प्रगल्भा परमोदारा परामोदा मनोमयी ॥ १७३ ॥

viśvamātā jagaddhātrī viśālākṣī virāgiṇī
pragalbhā paramodārā parāmodā manomayī

174

व्योमकेशी विमानस्था वज्रिणी वामकेश्वरी ।
पञ्चयज्ञप्रिया पञ्चप्रेतमञ्चाधिशायिनी ॥ १७४ ॥

vyomakeśī vimānasthā vajriṇī vāmakeśvarī
pañcayajñapriyā pañcapretamañcādhiśāyinī

175

पञ्चमी पञ्चभूतेशी पञ्चसङ्ख्योपचारिणी ।
शाश्वती शाश्वतैश्वर्या शर्मदा शम्भुमोहिनी ॥ १७५ ॥

pañcamī pañcabhūteśī pañcasaṅkhyopacāriṇī
śāśvatī śāśvataiśvaryā śarmadā śambhumohinī

176

धराधरसुता धन्या धर्मिणी धर्मवर्धिनी ।
लोकातीता गुणातीता सर्वातीता शमात्मिका ॥ १७६ ॥

dharādharasutā dhanyā dharmiṇī dharmavardhinī
lokātītā guṇātītā sarvātītā śamātmikā

177

बन्धूककुसुमप्रख्या बाला लीलाविनोदिनी ।
सुमङ्गली सुखकरी सुवेषाढ्या सुवासिनी ॥ १७७ ॥

bandhūkakusumaprakhyā bālā līlāvinodinī
sumaṅgalī sukhakarī suveṣāḍhyā suvāsinī

178

सुवासिन्यर्चनप्रीताऽऽशोभना शुद्धमानसा ।
बिन्दुतर्पणसन्तुष्टा पूर्वजा त्रिपुराम्बिका ॥ १७८ ॥

suvāsinyarcanaprītā''śobhanā śuddhamānasā
bindutarpaṇasantuṣṭā pūrvajā tripurāmbikā

179

दशमुद्रासमाराध्या त्रिपुराश्रीवशङ्करी ।
ज्ञानमुद्रा ज्ञानगम्या ज्ञानज्ञेयस्वरूपिणी ॥ १७९ ॥

daśamudrāsamārādhyā tripurāśrīvaśaṅkarī
jñānamudrā jñānagamyā jñānajñeyasvarūpiṇī

180

योनिमुद्रा त्रिखण्डेशी त्रिगुणाम्बा त्रिकोणगा ।
अनघाऽद्भुतचारित्रा वाञ्छितार्थप्रदायिनी ॥ १८० ॥

yonimudrā trikhaṇḍeśī triguṇāmbā trikoṇagā
anaghā'dbhutacāritrā vāñchitārthapradāyinī

181

अभ्यासातिशयज्ञाता षडध्वातीतरूपिणी ।
अव्याजकरुणामूर्तिरज्ञानध्वान्तदीपिका ॥ १८१ ॥

abhyāsātiśayajñātā ṣaḍadhvātītarūpiṇī
avyājakaruṇāmūrtirajñānadhvāntadīpikā

182

आबालगोपविदिता सर्वानुल्लङ्घ्यशासना ।
श्रीचक्रराजनिलया श्रीमत्त्रिपुरसुन्दरी ॥ १८२ ॥

ābālagopaviditā sarvānullaṅghyaśāsanā
śrīcakrarājanilayā śrīmattripurasundarī

183

श्रीशिवा शिवशक्त्यैक्यरूपिणी ललिताम्बिका ।
एवं श्रीललितादेव्या नाम्नां साहस्रकं जगुः ॥ १८३ ॥

śrīśivā śivaśaktyaikyarūpiṇī lalitāmbikā
evaṃ śrīlalitādevyā nāmnāṃ sāhasrakaṃ jaguḥ

Śloka-by-śloka analysis

Śloka 1

श्रीमाता श्रीमहाराज्ञी श्रीमत्सिंहासनेश्वरी ।
चिदग्निकुण्डसम्भूता देवकार्यसमुद्यता ॥ १ ॥

śrīmātā śrīmahārājñī śrīmatsiṃhāsaneśvarī |
cidagnikuṇḍasambhūtā devakāryasamudyatā || 1 ||

Names in this śloka

  1. श्रीमाता śrī-mātā
  2. श्रीमहाराज्ञी śrī-mahā-rājñī
  3. श्रीमत्सिंहासनेश्वरी śrīmat-siṃhāsaneśvarī
  4. चिदग्निकुण्डसम्भूता cid-agni-kuṇḍa-sambhūtā
  5. देवकार्यसमुद्यता deva-kārya-samudyatā

Names 1–3 each open with śrī/śrīmat and are traditionally read together as creation, maintenance and dissolution; names 4–5 begin the Purāṇic account of Her appearance from the fire for the gods' task.

1श्रीमाताśrī-mātā
Sandhi viccheda
No sound change inside the name; the members stand as written.
Samāsa vigraha

karmadhāraya (śrī as qualifying/honorific first member); alternatively ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa

श्रीः माता श्रीमाता (श्रीः च असौ माता च); अथवा श्रियः माता श्रीमाता
śrīḥ mātā śrīmātā (śrīḥ ca asau mātā ca); athavā śriyaḥ mātā śrīmātā

Two analyses are current, and both make mātā 'mother' the head. As a karmadhāraya, śrī stands in apposition to mātā: 'the Mother who is Śrī', i.e. auspicious, glorious, the source of all prosperity. As a ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa, śrī is the goddess Śrī (Lakṣmī): 'the mother of Śrī'. Śrī and mātā are simply juxtaposed; there is no sound change.

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning
श्रीśrīauspiciousness, glory, splendor; also the goddess Śrī (Lakṣmī)
माताmātāmother — nominative singular of the stem mātṛ

Complete meaning She who is the auspicious Mother

Spiritual significance Traditionally the first three names are read together as the three cosmic functions: as Mother She brings forth the worlds (sṛṣṭi), as Empress She sustains them (sthiti), and as Sovereign of the lion-throne She withdraws them (saṃhāra). She is Mother even of Lakṣmī and Sarasvatī.

Uncertain Two compound analyses are current: karmadhāraya ('the auspicious Mother') and ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa ('Mother of Śrī/Lakṣmī'). The meaning follows the first; the second is given in the samāsa note.

2श्रीमहाराज्ञीśrī-mahā-rājñī
Sandhi viccheda
No sound change inside the name; the members stand as written.
Samāsa vigraha

karmadhāraya (with an inner karmadhāraya)

महती राज्ञी महाराज्ञी; श्रीः महाराज्ञी श्रीमहाराज्ञी
mahatī rājñī mahārājñī; śrīḥ mahārājñī śrīmahārājñī

Inner layer: mahatī rājñī 'the great queen'. In a karmadhāraya the feminine adjective mahatī takes its masculine stem (puṃvadbhāva, Pāṇini 6.3.42), and mahat then becomes mahā- before a co-referential member (6.3.46 ān mahataḥ samānādhikaraṇa-jātīyayoḥ): mahā-rājñī. Rājñī is the feminine of rājan 'king' and is the head. Outer layer: śrī qualifies mahārājñī as in name 1. These are morphological replacements, not sound-sandhi; the members meet without phonetic change.

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning
श्रीśrīauspicious, glorious (honorific)
महत्mahatgreat — appears as mahā- in a karmadhāraya (Pāṇini 6.3.46)
राज्ञीrājñīqueen — feminine of rājan 'king'

Complete meaning She who is the auspicious great Empress

Spiritual significance Traditionally the second of the three opening names: as Empress She sustains and governs all the worlds (sthiti) that She brought forth as Mother.

3श्रीमत्सिंहासनेश्वरीśrīmat-siṃhāsaneśvarī
Sandhi viccheda
  • सिंहासन → सिंह + आसन (siṃha + āsana) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ), inside the lexicalised compound siṃhāsana 'throne'
  • सिंहासनेश्वरी → सिंहासन + ईश्वरी (siṃhāsana + īśvarī) — guṇa: a + ī → e (Pāṇini 6.1.87 ād guṇaḥ)
Samāsa vigraha

ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa (with an inner karmadhāraya)

श्रीमत् सिंहासनम् श्रीमत्सिंहासनम्; श्रीमत्सिंहासनस्य ईश्वरी श्रीमत्सिंहासनेश्वरी
śrīmat siṃhāsanam śrīmatsiṃhāsanam; śrīmatsiṃhāsanasya īśvarī śrīmatsiṃhāsaneśvarī

Inner layer: the adjective śrīmat 'glorious' qualifies siṃhāsana 'lion-seat, throne' (karmadhāraya). Outer layer: īśvarī 'sovereign, ruling lady' is the head and the throne stands to it in the genitive relation: 'the sovereign of the glorious throne'. Grammatically śrīmat could also qualify the sovereign herself (śrīmatī reduced to śrīmat by puṃvadbhāva), but the usual reading attaches it to the throne.

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning
श्रीमत्śrīmatglorious, splendid — śrī + the possessive suffix -mat
सिंहासनsiṃhāsanathrone (lit. 'lion-seat') — siṃha 'lion' + āsana 'seat'
ईश्वरीīśvarīsovereign, ruling lady — feminine of īśvara, from √īś 'to rule'

Complete meaning She who is the queen of the most glorious throne

Spiritual significance Traditionally the third of the opening triad, dissolution (saṃhāra): the One enthroned as supreme sovereign, into whom all that She created and sustained is finally withdrawn.

4चिदग्निकुण्डसम्भूताcid-agni-kuṇḍa-sambhūtā
Sandhi viccheda
  • चिदग्नि → चित् + अग्नि (cit + agni) — jaśtva: a final t becomes d before a voiced sound (Pāṇini 8.2.39 jhalāṃ jaśo 'nte)
Samāsa vigraha

pañcamī-tatpuruṣa (with an inner ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa and an inner karmadhāraya)

चित् एव अग्निः चिदग्निः; चिदग्नेः कुण्डम् चिदग्निकुण्डम्; चिदग्निकुण्डात् सम्भूता चिदग्निकुण्डसम्भूता
cit eva agniḥ cidagniḥ; cidagneḥ kuṇḍam cidagnikuṇḍam; cidagnikuṇḍāt sambhūtā cidagnikuṇḍasambhūtā

Built in three layers. (1) cit-agni 'the fire that is consciousness': a karmadhāraya of identification (rūpaka) — consciousness itself is the fire. (2) cidagni-kuṇḍa 'the altar-pit of that fire': ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa, kuṇḍa is the head. (3) The participle sambhūtā 'arisen' is the head of the whole and the fire-pit stands to it in the ablative: 'arisen from'. A locative reading (cidagnikuṇḍe sambhūtā, saptamī-tatpuruṣa, 'born in the fire-pit') is also current; the sense hardly changes.

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning
चित्citpure consciousness
अग्निagnifire
कुण्डkuṇḍafire-pit, sacrificial altar-pit
सम्भूताsambhūtāarisen, born — sam + √bhū 'to come into being', past participle, feminine

Complete meaning She who arose from the fire-altar of pure consciousness

Spiritual significance In the Lalitopākhyāna of the Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa the Goddess appears from the sacrificial fire kindled by the gods for the war against Bhaṇḍa. Inwardly, the fire is consciousness itself, in which ignorance and duality are offered up.

Uncertain Ablative ('arisen from') and locative ('born in') analyses of the last member are both current.

5देवकार्यसमुद्यताdeva-kārya-samudyatā
Sandhi viccheda
No sound change inside the name; the members stand as written.
Samāsa vigraha

saptamī-tatpuruṣa (with an inner ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa)

देवानाम् कार्यम् देवकार्यम्; देवकार्ये समुद्यता देवकार्यसमुद्यता
devānām kāryam devakāryam; devakārye samudyatā devakāryasamudyatā

Inner layer: deva-kārya 'the task of the gods' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa, kārya is the head). Outer layer: the participle samudyatā 'ready, set upon, intent' is the head and governs the locative: 'intent upon the gods' task'. A caturthī reading ('ready for the sake of the gods' task') gives the same sense.

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning
देवdevagod
कार्यkāryatask, work, purpose (lit. 'what is to be done') — √kṛ 'to do' + the gerundive suffix -ya
समुद्यताsamudyatāready, intent upon, set to work — sam + ud + √yam 'to raise', past participle, feminine: lit. 'with arms raised for the work'

Complete meaning She who is intent on accomplishing the task of the gods

Spiritual significance In the Purāṇa the gods' task is the destruction of the demon Bhaṇḍa, for which She arose (name 4). Traditionally it is also read as Her readiness to protect all who live by dharma.

Śloka 2

उद्यद्भानुसहस्राभा चतुर्बाहुसमन्विता ।
रागस्वरूपपाशाढ्या क्रोधाकाराङ्कुशोज्ज्वला ॥ २ ॥

udyadbhānusahasrābhā caturbāhusamanvitā |
rāgasvarūpapāśāḍhyā krodhākārāṅkuśojjvalā || 2 ||

Names in this śloka

  1. उद्यद्भानुसहस्राभा udyad-bhānu-sahasrābhā
  2. चतुर्बाहुसमन्विता catur-bāhu-samanvitā
  3. रागस्वरूपपाशाढ्या rāga-svarūpa-pāśāḍhyā
  4. क्रोधाकाराङ्कुशोज्ज्वला krodhākārāṅkuśojjvalā

Names 8–11 (running into śloka 3) name the four emblems held in the four hands of name 7.

6उद्यद्भानुसहस्राभाudyad-bhānu-sahasrābhā
Sandhi viccheda
  • उद्यद्भानु → उद्यत् + भानु (udyat + bhānu) — jaśtva: a final t becomes d before a voiced sound (Pāṇini 8.2.39 jhalāṃ jaśo 'nte)
  • सहस्राभा → सहस्र + आभा (sahasra + ābhā) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)
Samāsa vigraha

bahuvrīhi of comparison (over an inner ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa and an inner karmadhāraya)

उद्यन्तः भानवः उद्यद्भानवः; उद्यद्भानूनाम् सहस्रम् उद्यद्भानुसहस्रम्; उद्यद्भानुसहस्रस्य आभा इव आभा यस्याः सा उद्यद्भानुसहस्राभा
udyantaḥ bhānavaḥ udyadbhānavaḥ; udyadbhānūnām sahasram udyadbhānusahasram; udyadbhānusahasrasya ābhā iva ābhā yasyāḥ sā udyadbhānusahasrābhā

(1) udyad-bhānu 'rising sun(s)': the present participle udyat qualifies bhānu (karmadhāraya). (2) udyadbhānu-sahasra 'a thousand rising suns' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa, sahasra is the head). (3) The whole is a bahuvrīhi describing Her: 'She whose radiance (ābhā) is like that of a thousand rising suns'. The name could also be taken as a tatpuruṣa in apposition ('She who is the radiance of …'); the image is the same.

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning
उद्यत्udyatrising — ud + √i 'to go', present participle: 'going up'
भानुbhānusun
सहस्रsahasraa thousand; countless
आभाābhāradiance, splendor, appearance

Complete meaning She who has the radiance of a thousand rising suns

Spiritual significance The crimson of the rising sun is Her own color throughout the hymn; 'a thousand' is traditionally taken to mean beyond counting, a brilliance that is nonetheless gentle like dawn.

7चतुर्बाहुसमन्विताcatur-bāhu-samanvitā
Sandhi viccheda
  • अन्विता → अनु + इता (anu + itā) — yaṇ: u becomes v before a dissimilar vowel (Pāṇini 6.1.77 iko yaṇ aci), at the junction of the prefix anu with ita
Samāsa vigraha

tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa (with an inner dvigu)

चत्वारः बाहवः चतुर्बाहवः; चतुर्भिः बाहुभिः समन्विता चतुर्बाहुसमन्विता
catvāraḥ bāhavaḥ caturbāhavaḥ; caturbhiḥ bāhubhiḥ samanvitā caturbāhusamanvitā

Inner layer: catur-bāhu 'four arms', a numeral + noun karmadhāraya, i.e. a dvigu, allowed here because another member follows (Pāṇini 2.1.51–52). Outer layer: the participle samanvitā 'endowed with' is the head and the four arms stand to it in the instrumental. The r of catur is original, so it stays r before the voiced b; no visarga arises.

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning
चतुर्caturfour
बाहुbāhuarm
समन्विताsamanvitāendowed with, accompanied by — sam + anu + √i 'to go', past participle, feminine

Complete meaning She who is four-armed

Spiritual significance The four arms carry the four emblems named next: the noose, the goad, the sugarcane bow and the flower arrows (names 8–11).

8रागस्वरूपपाशाढ्याrāga-svarūpa-pāśāḍhyā
Sandhi viccheda
  • पाशाढ्या → पाश + आढ्या (pāśa + āḍhyā) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)
Samāsa vigraha

tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa (over an inner karmadhāraya and an inner bahuvrīhi)

रागः स्वरूपम् यस्य सः रागस्वरूपः; रागस्वरूपः पाशः रागस्वरूपपाशः; रागस्वरूपपाशेन आढ्या रागस्वरूपपाशाढ्या
rāgaḥ svarūpam yasya saḥ rāgasvarūpaḥ; rāgasvarūpaḥ pāśaḥ rāgasvarūpapāśaḥ; rāgasvarūpapāśena āḍhyā rāgasvarūpapāśāḍhyā

(1) rāga-svarūpa 'whose very nature is desire' — a bahuvrīhi that qualifies the noose. (2) rāgasvarūpa-pāśa 'the noose whose nature is desire' (karmadhāraya, pāśa is the head). (3) āḍhyā 'rich in, furnished with' is the head of the whole and takes the noose in the instrumental: 'furnished with that noose'.

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning
रागrāgadesire, attachment, passion; also love
स्वरूपsvarūpaown form, very nature — sva 'own' + rūpa 'form'
पाशpāśanoose, cord
आढ्याāḍhyārich in, furnished with

Complete meaning She who holds the noose whose very nature is desire (rāga)

Spiritual significance In Śrīvidyā the noose is commonly read as icchā-śakti, the power of will: the binding pull of attachment is itself held in Her hand, so She can bind devotees to Herself and loosen worldly ties.

9क्रोधाकाराङ्कुशोज्ज्वलाkrodhākārāṅkuśojjvalā
Sandhi viccheda
  • क्रोधाकार → क्रोध + आकार (krodha + ākāra) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)
  • आकाराङ्कुश → आकार + अङ्कुश (ākāra + aṅkuśa) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + a → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)
  • अङ्कुशोज्ज्वला → अङ्कुश + उज्ज्वला (aṅkuśa + ujjvalā) — guṇa: a + u → o (Pāṇini 6.1.87 ād guṇaḥ)
  • उज्ज्वला → उद् + ज्वला (ud + jvalā) — the prefix ud assimilates to the following palatal: d becomes j before j (ścutva, Pāṇini 8.4.40 stoḥ ścunā ścuḥ)
Samāsa vigraha

tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa (over an inner karmadhāraya and an inner bahuvrīhi)

क्रोधः आकारः यस्य सः क्रोधाकारः; क्रोधाकारः अङ्कुशः क्रोधाकाराङ्कुशः; क्रोधाकाराङ्कुशेन उज्ज्वला क्रोधाकाराङ्कुशोज्ज्वला
krodhaḥ ākāraḥ yasya saḥ krodhākāraḥ; krodhākāraḥ aṅkuśaḥ krodhākārāṅkuśaḥ; krodhākārāṅkuśena ujjvalā krodhākārāṅkuśojjvalā

Parallel to name 8. (1) krodha-ākāra 'whose form is anger' — a bahuvrīhi qualifying the goad. (2) krodhākāra-aṅkuśa 'the goad that has the form of anger' (karmadhāraya). (3) ujjvalā 'blazing, resplendent' is the head and takes the goad in the instrumental: 'resplendent with that goad'. Every junction fuses its vowels, so the name cannot be hyphenated.

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning
क्रोधkrodhaanger
आकारākāraform, shape
अङ्कुशaṅkuśagoad (elephant-hook)
उज्ज्वलाujjvalāblazing, resplendent — ud + √jval 'to blaze', feminine

Complete meaning She who is resplendent with the goad that has the form of anger

Spiritual significance The goad restrains and directs, as the noose binds. In Śrīvidyā it is commonly read as jñāna-śakti, the power of knowledge; anger itself, held by Her, becomes a force that curbs what is wrong.

Śloka 3

मनोरूपेक्षुकोदण्डा पञ्चतन्मात्रसायका ।
निजारुणप्रभापूरमज्जद्ब्रह्माण्डमण्डला ॥ ३ ॥

manorūpekṣukodaṇḍā pañcatanmātrasāyakā |
nijāruṇaprabhāpūramajjadbrahmāṇḍamaṇḍalā || 3 ||

Names in this śloka

  1. मनोरूपेक्षुकोदण्डा mano-rūpekṣu-kodaṇḍā
  2. पञ्चतन्मात्रसायका pañca-tanmātra-sāyakā
  3. निजारुणप्रभापूरमज्जद्ब्रह्माण्डमण्डला nijāruṇa-prabhā-pūra-majjad-brahmāṇḍa-maṇḍalā

Name 12 fills the whole second half; its participle majjat 'sinking' is intransitive (the universe is immersed).

10मनोरूपेक्षुकोदण्डाmano-rūpekṣu-kodaṇḍā
Sandhi viccheda
  • मनोरूप → मनस् + रूप (manas + rūpa) — visarga sandhi: final s becomes ru (Pāṇini 8.2.66 sasajuṣo ruḥ), which after a and before a voiced consonant becomes u (6.1.113–114 ato ror aplutād aplute, haśi ca); a + u then gives o (6.1.87)
  • रूपेक्षु → रूप + इक्षु (rūpa + ikṣu) — guṇa: a + i → e (Pāṇini 6.1.87 ād guṇaḥ)
Samāsa vigraha

bahuvrīhi (over an inner karmadhāraya, an inner bahuvrīhi and an inner ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa)

मनः रूपम् यस्य सः मनोरूपः; इक्षोः कोदण्डः इक्षुकोदण्डः; मनोरूपः इक्षुकोदण्डः मनोरूपेक्षुकोदण्डः; मनोरूपेक्षुकोदण्डः यस्याः सा मनोरूपेक्षुकोदण्डा
manaḥ rūpam yasya saḥ manorūpaḥ; ikṣoḥ kodaṇḍaḥ ikṣukodaṇḍaḥ; manorūpaḥ ikṣukodaṇḍaḥ manorūpekṣukodaṇḍaḥ; manorūpekṣukodaṇḍaḥ yasyāḥ sā manorūpekṣukodaṇḍā

(1) mano-rūpa 'whose form is the mind' — a bahuvrīhi qualifying the bow. (2) ikṣu-kodaṇḍa 'bow of sugarcane' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa of material). (3) The two combine as a karmadhāraya, 'the sugarcane bow that is the mind'. (4) The whole is a bahuvrīhi describing Her, 'She whose bow is …'; kodaṇḍa takes the feminine ending -ā to agree with Her (Pāṇini 4.1.4 ajādyataṣ ṭāp).

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning
मनस्manasmind
रूपrūpaform
इक्षुikṣusugarcane
कोदण्डाkodaṇḍābow — kodaṇḍa 'bow', with the feminine -ā of the bahuvrīhi

Complete meaning She who holds in Her hand a sugarcane bow that represents the mind

Spiritual significance The sugarcane bow is Kāma's, made sweet; here it is the mind from which the arrows of the senses are loosed. In Śrīvidyā the bow and arrows together are commonly read as kriyā-śakti, the power of action.

Inner layer: pañca-tanmātra 'the five subtle elements', a numeral compound (dvigu) before a further member. Outer layer: a bahuvrīhi, 'She whose arrows are the five subtle elements'; sāyaka takes the feminine -ā. The stem pañcan drops its final n in composition (Pāṇini 8.2.7 nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya).

(1) vaktra-lakṣmī 'the beauty of the face' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa; lakṣmī here means beauty, not the goddess). (2) …lakṣmī-parīvāha 'the overflowing stream of that beauty' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (3) …parīvāha-calat 'darting in that stream' (saptamī-tatpuruṣa with the participle), qualifying mīna 'fish' (karmadhāraya). (4) …mīna-ābha 'looking like those fish' (bahuvrīhi of resemblance), qualifying locana 'eye'. (5) The whole is a bahuvrīhi: 'She whose eyes are like fish darting in the stream of Her face's beauty'.

(1) nava-vidruma 'fresh coral' (karmadhāraya). (2) …vidruma-bimba 'fresh coral and the bimba fruit' (itaretara-dvandva). (3) …bimba-śrī 'their beauty' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (4) …śrī-nyakkārin 'humbling that beauty' (upapada-tatpuruṣa; agent noun in -in from nyak + √kṛ, final n dropped). (5) radana-chada 'the covering of the teeth', i.e. the lip (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa), qualified by (4). (6) The whole is a bahuvrīhi: 'She whose lips humble the beauty of fresh coral and the bimba fruit'.

  • कामेश → काम + ईश (kāma + īśa) — guṇa: a + ī → e (Pāṇini 6.1.87 ād guṇaḥ), inside the lexicalised name Kāmeśa
Samāsa vigraha

bahuvrīhi (over inner tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣas and karmadhārayas)

कामेशेन बद्धम् कामेशबद्धम्; माङ्गल्यम् सूत्रम् माङ्गल्यसूत्रम्; कामेशबद्धम् माङ्गल्यसूत्रम् कामेशबद्धमाङ्गल्यसूत्रम्; कामेशबद्धमाङ्गल्यसूत्रेण शोभिता कामेशबद्धमाङ्गल्यसूत्रशोभिता; कामेशबद्धमाङ्गल्यसूत्रशोभिता कन्धरा यस्याः सा कामेशबद्धमाङ्गल्यसूत्रशोभितकन्धरा
kāmeśena baddham kāmeśabaddham; māṅgalyam sūtram māṅgalyasūtram; kāmeśabaddham māṅgalyasūtram kāmeśabaddhamāṅgalyasūtram; kāmeśabaddhamāṅgalyasūtreṇa śobhitā kāmeśabaddhamāṅgalyasūtraśobhitā; kāmeśabaddhamāṅgalyasūtraśobhitā kandharā yasyāḥ sā kāmeśabaddhamāṅgalyasūtraśobhitakandharā

(1) kāmeśa-baddha 'tied by Kāmeśa' (tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa: agent in the instrumental with a past participle). (2) māṅgalya-sūtra 'the auspicious thread', the marriage thread (karmadhāraya), qualified by (1). (3) śobhitā 'adorned' takes that thread in the instrumental (tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa). (4) The whole is a bahuvrīhi: 'She whose neck is adorned with …'; śobhitā takes its masculine stem inside the bahuvrīhi (puṃvadbhāva), and kandharā 'neck' ends the name.

Complete meaning She whose neck is adorned with the marriage thread tied by Kāmeśa

Spiritual significance The māṅgalyasūtra is the emblem of the wedded wife. Traditionally it marks the eternal union of Kāmeśvara and Kāmeśvarī, Śiva and Śakti, who are never apart.

kanakāṅgadakeyūrakamanīyabhujānvitā |

tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa (over inner karmadhārayas, a tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa and a dvandva)

अङ्गदानि च केयूराणि च अङ्गदकेयूराणि; कनकमयानि अङ्गदकेयूराणि कनकाङ्गदकेयूराणि; कनकाङ्गदकेयूरैः कमनीयाः कनकाङ्गदकेयूरकमनीयाः; कनकाङ्गदकेयूरकमनीयाः भुजाः कनकाङ्गदकेयूरकमनीयभुजाः; तैः अन्विता कनकाङ्गदकेयूरकमनीयभुजान्विता
aṅgadāni ca keyūrāṇi ca aṅgadakeyūrāṇi; kanakamayāni aṅgadakeyūrāṇi kanakāṅgadakeyūrāṇi; kanakāṅgadakeyūraiḥ kamanīyāḥ kanakāṅgadakeyūrakamanīyāḥ; kanakāṅgadakeyūrakamanīyāḥ bhujāḥ kanakāṅgadakeyūrakamanīyabhujāḥ; taiḥ anvitā kanakāṅgadakeyūrakamanīyabhujānvitā

(1) aṅgada and keyūra, two kinds of upper-arm ornament, form a dvandva. (2) kanaka 'gold' qualifies them with the middle word 'made of' understood (karmadhāraya). Since aṅgada stands next to kanaka, one may also take kanaka with aṅgada alone ('golden aṅgadas and keyūras'); the sense is the same. (3) kamanīya 'lovely' takes the ornaments in the instrumental (tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa) and (4) qualifies bhuja 'arm' (karmadhāraya). (5) The participle anvitā 'endowed with' is the head and takes the arms in the instrumental.

  • अन्विता → अनु + इता (anu + itā) — yaṇ: u becomes v before a dissimilar vowel (Pāṇini 6.1.77 iko yaṇ aci), at the junction of the prefix anu with ita
Samāsa vigraha

tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa (over an itaretara-dvandva of three members, with inner karmadhārayas)

रत्नखचितम् ग्रैवेयम् रत्नग्रैवेयम्; लोलानि मुक्ताफलानि लोलमुक्ताफलानि; रत्नग्रैवेयम् च चिन्ताकम् च लोलमुक्ताफलानि च रत्नग्रैवेयचिन्ताकलोलमुक्ताफलानि; तैः अन्विता रत्नग्रैवेयचिन्ताकलोलमुक्ताफलान्विता
ratnakhacitam graiveyam ratnagraiveyam; lolāni muktāphalāni lolamuktāphalāni; ratnagraiveyam ca cintākam ca lolamuktāphalāni ca ratnagraiveyacintākalolamuktāphalāni; taiḥ anvitā ratnagraiveyacintākalolamuktāphalānvitā

(1) ratna-graiveya 'a necklace set with gems' (karmadhāraya with the middle word 'set with' dropped). (2) lola-muktāphala 'swaying pearls' (karmadhāraya). (3) These and cintāka, a neck ornament, are joined as an itaretara-dvandva: 'the jewelled necklace, the cintāka and the swaying pearls'. (4) The participle anvitā 'endowed with, wearing' is the head and takes them in the instrumental. muktāphala 'pearl' is one word (lit. 'pearl-fruit'); its phala belongs to it, not to anvitā.

रत्नratnagem, jewel
ग्रैवेयgraiveyanecklace — from grīvā 'neck'
चिन्ताकcintākacintāka, a neck ornament (collar or pendant) — a rare word known from this name and its commentators; a close-fitting necklace of this name is still worn in western and southern India

Complete meaning She who is adorned with a jewelled necklace, a cintāka and swaying pearls

Spiritual significance Another stage of the description of Her form, at the neck and breast; the ornaments of the Goddess are part of Her worship (bhūṣaṇa), offered to Her in pūjā.

Uncertain The exact form of the cintāka is not certain: it is taken as a gold collar-necklace or as the pendant (locket) of the jewelled necklace. On the second reading the analysis is 'the jewelled necklace with its pendant, and swaying pearls'.

Samāsa vigraha

bahuvrīhi (over inner ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas and karmadhārayas)

kāmeśvarasya prema kāmeśvaraprema; ratnam maṇiḥ ratnamaṇiḥ; kāmeśvaraprema eva ratnamaṇiḥ kāmeśvarapremaratnamaṇiḥ; kāmeśvarapremaratnamaṇeḥ pratipaṇau kāmeśvarapremaratnamaṇipratipaṇau; kāmeśvarapremaratnamaṇipratipaṇau stanau yasyāḥ sā kāmeśvarapremaratnamaṇipratipaṇastanī

(1) kāmeśvara-prema 'Kāmeśvara's love' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (2) ratna-maṇi 'a precious gem' (karmadhāraya of two words for jewel), and (1) is identified with it: 'the precious gem that is Kāmeśvara's love' (rūpaka karmadhāraya).   • रोमालि → रोम + आलि (roma + āli) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)

नाभिः एव आलवालम् नाभ्यालवालम्; रोम्णाम् आलिः रोमालिः; रोमालिः एव लता रोमालिलता; नाभ्यालवाले रोमालिलता नाभ्यालवालरोमालिलता; नाभ्यालवालरोमालिलतायाः फलम् नाभ्यालवालरोमालिलताफलम्; कुचयोः द्वयी कुचद्वयी; नाभ्यालवालरोमालिलताफलम् कुचद्वयी यस्याः सा नाभ्यालवालरोमालिलताफलकुचद्वयी
nābhiḥ eva ālavālam nābhyālavālam; romṇām āliḥ romāliḥ; romāliḥ eva latā romālilatā; nābhyālavāle romālilatā nābhyālavālaromālilatā; nābhyālavālaromālilatāyāḥ phalam nābhyālavālaromālilatāphalam; kucayoḥ dvayī kucadvayī; nābhyālavālaromālilatāphalam kucadvayī yasyāḥ sā nābhyālavālaromālilatāphalakucadvayī

Spiritual significance A classical figure of Sanskrit poetry, carried through every member: the navel is the basin that waters the plant, the fine line of hair the creeper rising from it, and the breasts its fruit.

Names in this śloka

  1. लक्ष्यरोमलताधारतासमुन्नेयमध्यमा lakṣya-roma-latādhāratā-samunneya-madhyamā

Name 35: divide latā + ādhāratā 'being the support', not latā + dhāratā; the ā of ādhāratā is fused with latā. Name 36: dalan- is the participle dalat, its t nasalised before madhya.

Sandhi viccheda
  • लताधारता → लता + आधारता (latā + ādhāratā) — savarṇa-dīrgha: ā + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ); the second member is ādhāratā 'being the support', not dhāratā — the fused ā hides the boundary
  • उन्नेय → उद् + नेय (ud + neya) — nasal assimilation: the d of the prefix ud becomes n before the nasal n (Pāṇini 8.4.45 yaro 'nunāsike 'nunāsiko vā)

romṇām latā romalatā; lakṣyā romalatā lakṣyaromalatā; lakṣyaromalatāyāḥ ādhāratā lakṣyaromalatādhāratā; lakṣyaromalatādhāratayā samunneyam lakṣyaromalatādhāratāsamunneyam; lakṣyaromalatādhāratāsamunneyam madhyamam yasyāḥ sā lakṣyaromalatādhāratāsamunneyamadhyamā

bahuvrīhi (over inner tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa, karmadhārayas and ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas)

स्तनयोः भारः स्तनभारः; स्तनभारेण दलत् स्तनभारदलत्; स्तनभारदलत् मध्यम् स्तनभारदलन्मध्यम्; पट्टस्य बन्धः पट्टबन्धः; स्तनभारदलन्मध्यस्य पट्टबन्धः स्तनभारदलन्मध्यपट्टबन्धः; वलीनाम् त्रयम् वलित्रयम्; स्तनभारदलन्मध्यपट्टबन्धरूपम् वलित्रयम् यस्याः सा स्तनभारदलन्मध्यपट्टबन्धवलित्रया
stanayoḥ bhāraḥ stanabhāraḥ; stanabhāreṇa dalat stanabhāradalat; stanabhāradalat madhyam stanabhāradalanmadhyam; paṭṭasya bandhaḥ paṭṭabandhaḥ; stanabhāradalanmadhyasya paṭṭabandhaḥ stanabhāradalanmadhyapaṭṭabandhaḥ; valīnām trayam valitrayam; stanabhāradalanmadhyapaṭṭabandharūpam valitrayam yasyāḥ sā stanabhāradalanmadhyapaṭṭabandhavalitrayā

(1) stana-bhāra 'the weight of the breasts' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (2) The present participle dalat 'splitting, cracking' takes that weight in the instrumental (tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa), and (3) qualifies madhya 'waist' (karmadhāraya): 'the waist that seems to crack under the weight'. (4) paṭṭa-bandha 'a binding band' for that waist (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas). (5) vali-traya 'the three folds' is identified with that band, the word 'in the form of' (rūpa) understood. (6) The whole is a bahuvrīhi: 'She whose three folds are a binding band for Her waist …'; traya takes the feminine -ā.

Complete meaning She whose three folds of skin form a band that binds Her waist, as though it would break under the weight of Her breasts

Spiritual significance The trivalī, three folds across the midriff, is a classical mark of beauty; the poet imagines them as a band tied by nature round a waist too slender for its burden.

Complete meaning She whose hips shine with a safflower-dyed garment as red as the dawn

Spiritual significance Red is Her color throughout the hymn; its dhyāna verses picture Her as aruṇā, red, and in red garlands, ornaments and garments (aruṇa-mālya-bhūṣāmbarām). Traditionally the red is read as compassion and the passion (rāga) of creative power.

Uncertain aruṇāruṇa may be read as 'red as the dawn' (upamāna, as analysed) or as the color word doubled for emphasis, 'deep red, red upon red'.

Spiritual significance The comparison is to Kāma's quiver, which holds the flower-arrows; in this hymn those arrows are Her own (name 11). The scarlet indragopas, like the ruby knees of name 40, keep the description in Her color, red.

Uncertain Translators take indragopa here either as the scarlet insects themselves, scattered over the quiver, or as red gems of their color set around it; the comparison of the calves to Kāma's quiver is not in doubt.

44नखदीधितिसञ्छन्ननमज्जनतमोगुणाnakha-dīdhiti-sañchanna-namaj-jana-tamo-guṇā
Sandhi viccheda
  • सञ्छन्न → सम् + छन्न (sam + channa) — the m of the prefix sam becomes anusvāra and then the palatal nasal ñ before ch (Pāṇini 8.3.23 mo 'nusvāraḥ; 8.4.58 anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ); written here with ñ, elsewhere as saṃchanna
  • नमज्जन → नमत् + जन (namat + jana) — the final t of the participle namat is voiced to d (jaśtva, Pāṇini 8.2.39) and assimilated to the following palatal j (ścutva, Pāṇini 8.4.40 stoḥ ścunā ścuḥ)
  • तमोगुण → तमस् + गुण (tamas + guṇa) — the final s becomes ru (Pāṇini 8.2.66 sasajuṣo ruḥ), which turns to u after a before a voiced consonant (6.1.114 haśi ca); a + u then gives o by guṇa (6.1.87)
Samāsa vigraha

bahuvrīhi (over inner tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa, karmadhārayas and ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas)

नखानाम् दीधितयः नखदीधितयः; नखदीधितिभिः सञ्छन्नः नखदीधितिसञ्छन्नः; नमन्तः जनाः नमज्जनाः; तमः गुणः तमोगुणः; नमज्जनानाम् तमोगुणः नमज्जनतमोगुणः; नखदीधितिसञ्छन्नः नमज्जनतमोगुणः यस्याः सा नखदीधितिसञ्छन्ननमज्जनतमोगुणा
nakhānām dīdhitayaḥ nakhadīdhitayaḥ; nakhadīdhitibhiḥ sañchannaḥ nakhadīdhitisañchannaḥ; namantaḥ janāḥ namajjanāḥ; tamaḥ guṇaḥ tamoguṇaḥ; namajjanānām tamoguṇaḥ namajjanatamoguṇaḥ; nakhadīdhitisañchannaḥ namajjanatamoguṇaḥ yasyāḥ sā nakhadīdhitisañchannanamajjanatamoguṇā

(1) nakha-dīdhiti 'the rays of the (toe)nails' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (2) sañchanna 'covered over, overwhelmed' takes the rays in the instrumental (tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa). (3) namaj-jana 'people who bow' (karmadhāraya of participle and noun). (4) tamo-guṇa 'the guṇa tamas', darkness, inertia, ignorance (karmadhāraya), and …jana-tamoguṇa 'the tamas of those who bow' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (5) The whole is a bahuvrīhi: 'She by the rays of whose toenails the tamas of those who bow is covered over', i.e. overwhelmed and dispelled by light; guṇa takes the feminine -ā.

नमत्namatbowing — √nam 'to bow', present participle
जनjanaperson, people

Complete meaning She the radiance of whose toenails overwhelms the darkness (tamoguṇa) of those who bow to Her

Spiritual significance Those who bow touch Her feet with their heads, and the light of Her toenails falls on them. Traditionally this is the removal of ignorance through surrender at Her feet.

Names in this śloka

Names 55–61 describe Her abode: the central peak of Meru, the city, the cintāmaṇi palace, the throne of the five Brahmas, the lotus and kadamba forests, the ocean of nectar. In 56 śrīman- is śrīmat with t → n before nagara.

(1) madhya-śṛṅga 'the middle peak' (karmadhāraya). (2) sumeru-madhyaśṛṅga 'the middle peak of Sumeru' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (3) -sthā 'abiding' (√sthā after a word in the locative, Pāṇini 3.2.4) is the head: 'She who abides on the middle peak of Sumeru'. The members are simply juxtaposed.

Uncertain Several analyses are current: kāma as 'lovely' (the meaning given), as 'love, desire' dwelling in Her eyes, and the traditional kā + mā + akṣī (Sarasvatī and Lakṣmī as Her eyes).

Samāsa vigraha

अश्वम् आरूढा अश्वारूढा; अश्वारूढया अधिष्ठिताः अश्वारूढाधिष्ठिताः; अश्वारूढाधिष्ठिताः अश्वाः अश्वारूढाधिष्ठिताश्वाः; कोटीनाम् कोटयः कोटिकोटयः; अश्वारूढाधिष्ठिताश्वानाम् कोटिकोटयः अश्वारूढाधिष्ठिताश्वकोटिकोटयः; अश्वारूढाधिष्ठिताश्वकोटिकोटिभिः आवृता

(1) aśva-ārūḍhā 'she who has mounted a horse', the name of the śakti Aśvārūḍhā (dvitīyā-tatpuruṣa). (2) adhiṣṭhita 'commanded, presided over' takes her as agent in the instrumental (tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa), and (3) qualifies aśva 'horse' (karmadhāraya). (4) koṭi-koṭi 'crores of crores', i.e. countless millions (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa), of those horses. This long compound is declined in the instrumental plural (…koṭibhiḥ) and is a separate word from āvṛtā 'surrounded', which governs it; the visarga becomes r before ā. Spiritual significance Traditionally the chariot Cakrarāja, 'king of cakras', is the Śrīcakra itself, its tiers occupied by the deities of the Śrīcakra's enclosures (āvaraṇa). Names 68–70 name the three chariots of the war.

Uncertain The compound can also be read with ārūḍha qualifying āyudha, 'equipped with all the weapons placed on the Cakrarāja chariot', parallel to names 69–70 where ārūḍha qualifies the following member. The meaning given follows the usual reading.

(3) mukha-paṅkaja 'the lotus that is the face' (rūpaka-karmadhāraya), which that bahuvrīhi qualifies. Sandhi viccheda
  • षट्चक्र → षष् + चक्र (ṣaṣ + cakra) — the final ṣ of ṣaṣ becomes ḍ at the end of a member (jaśtva, Pāṇini 8.2.39) and then ṭ before the voiceless c (cartva, 8.4.55 khari ca)
  • चक्रोपरि → चक्र + उपरि (cakra + upari) — guṇa: a + u → o (Pāṇini 6.1.87 ād guṇaḥ)
  • संस्थिता → सम् + स्थिता (sam + sthitā) — m becomes anusvāra before a consonant (Pāṇini 8.3.23 mo 'nusvāraḥ); before a sibilant it stays anusvāra: sam → saṃ
Samāsa vigraha

(1) ṣaṭ-cakra 'the six cakras' (a numeral compound, dvigu, before a further member). (2) …cakra-upari 'above the six cakras' (the indeclinable upari with the cakras in the genitive). (3) The head saṃsthitā 'established, abiding' is qualified by that place.

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning

चक्रcakracakra

Spiritual significance The six cakras are mūlādhāra, svādhiṣṭhāna, maṇipūra, anāhata, viśuddhi and ājñā; She abides above them in the sahasrāra.

Sandhi viccheda
  • महासक्ति → मह + आसक्ति (maha + āsakti) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ); the second member is āsakti 'attachment', its ā absorbed into maha

maha 'festival' and āsakti 'attachment' are in different cases (the festival in the locative), as in cakrapāṇi 'whose discus is in his hand': 'She whose attachment is to the festival'. āsakti is a feminine i-stem, so the name ends in -iḥ.

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning

Uncertain The division mahā + sakti 'great attachment' is also possible; maha 'festival' + āsakti 'attachment' is followed here because it explains the festive union of the traditional gloss.

Variants Many printed editions read महाशक्तिः (mahāśaktiḥ, 'the great power'); this edition follows the reading with dental s, महासक्तिः.

Names in this śloka

Where the names join in the śloka

  • भद्रमूर्तिर्भक्त → भद्रमूर्तिः + भक्त… (bhadramūrtiḥ + bhakta…) — visarga sandhi: final s becomes ru (Pāṇini 8.2.66 sasajuṣo ruḥ), which after i stays r before a voiced sound (it becomes visarga only before a voiceless sound or a pause, 8.3.15)

Name 113 can be divided bhāvanā-gamyā 'attainable through contemplation' or bhāvanā-agamyā 'unattainable by imagining'; the letters are the same. Names 112–125 turn to Her as Śiva's consort and to devotion.

112भवानीbhavānī
Sandhi viccheda

Samāsa vigraha
Not a compound.
Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning

Complete meaning She who is the consort of Bhava (Śiva)

Spiritual significance Bhava, 'existence', is Śiva as the one from whom all becoming arises; as Bhavānī She is the power that gives that existence life.

gamyā 'to be reached, attainable' (√gam + the gerundive -ya, feminine) is the head, and bhāvanā 'contemplation' stands to it in the instrumental: 'attainable through contemplation'. The text can also be divided bhāvanā + agamyā, with the a of agamyā absorbed into the long ā (savarṇa-dīrgha): 'unattainable by mere imagining'.

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning
भावनाbhāvanācontemplation, meditative realization — from the causative of √bhū "to become": "causing to become"

Uncertain Both divisions are traditional: bhāvanā-gamyā 'attainable through contemplation' and bhāvanā-agamyā 'unattainable through (mere) imagination'. The Devanagari is the same either way.

Names in this śloka

  1. निष्कारणा niṣ-kāraṇā
  2. निष्कलङ्का niṣ-kalaṅkā
  3. निरुपाधिः nir-upādhiḥ

  5. नीरागा nī-rāgā

Where the names join in the śloka

  • निरुपाधिर्निरीश्वरा → निरुपाधिः + निरीश्वरा (nirupādhiḥ + nirīśvarā) — visarga sandhi: final s becomes ru (Pāṇini 8.2.66 sasajuṣo ruḥ), which after i stays r before a voiced sound (it becomes visarga only before a voiceless sound or a pause, 8.3.15)

Name 156 is nī-rāgā (nis + rāga), not nīr + āgā. From here the names come in pairs, 'without X' and 'destroyer of X' (156–181); name 159 is mada-nāśinī, not madana + aśinī.

The prefix nis 'out, away' stands for nirgata 'gone out', whose participle is dropped in the compound (prādi-bahuvrīhi): 'She from whom parigraha (taking, possession) has gone out', i.e. 'She who is without parigraha (taking, possession)'. The name describes Her, so the last member takes the feminine ending.

Sandhi viccheda

Inner layer: un-manī 'she whose mind has risen beyond', a bahuvrīhi with the prefix ut 'up, beyond' (manas is shortened and takes the feminine -ī): the state in which the mind is transcended. Outer layer: manas-unmanī 'the transcending of the mind', with manas in the genitive. The name is a technical term of Śaiva and Śākta yoga and is not built by ordinary sandhi.

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning

Uncertain The junction mano + unmanī is not regular sandhi and the analysis of this technical term varies (some read manas + unmanī as a karmadhāraya, 'the mind that has become unmanī'); the meaning follows the common yogic sense.

  • उपचाराढ्या → उपचार + आढ्या (upacāra + āḍhyā) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + a/ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)

281उन्मेषनिमिषोत्पन्नविपन्नभुवनावलीunmeṣa-nimiṣotpanna-vipanna-bhuvanāvalī
Sandhi viccheda
  • उन्मेष → उत् + मेष (ut + meṣa) — a stop becomes the nasal of its class before a nasal: t → n (Pāṇini 8.4.45 yaro 'nunāsike 'nunāsiko vā)
  • निमिषोत्पन्न → निमिष + उत्पन्न (nimiṣa + utpanna) — guṇa: a + u → o (Pāṇini 6.1.87 ād guṇaḥ)
  • भुवनावली → भुवन + आवली (bhuvana + āvalī) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + a/ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)
Samāsa vigraha

bahuvrīhi (over an inner itaretara-dvandva, a karmadhāraya of two participles and a ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa)

उन्मेषः च निमिषः च उन्मेषनिमिषौ; उत्पन्ना च विपन्ना च उत्पन्नविपन्ना; भुवनानाम् आवली भुवनावली; उन्मेषनिमिषाभ्याम् उत्पन्नविपन्ना भुवनावली यस्याः सा उन्मेषनिमिषोत्पन्नविपन्नभुवनावली
unmeṣaḥ ca nimiṣaḥ ca unmeṣanimiṣau; utpannā ca vipannā ca utpannavipannā; bhuvanānām āvalī bhuvanāvalī; unmeṣanimiṣābhyām utpannavipannā bhuvanāvalī yasyāḥ sā unmeṣanimiṣotpannavipannabhuvanāvalī

(1) unmeṣa-nimiṣa 'the opening and the closing (of the eyes)' (dvandva). (2) utpanna-vipanna 'arisen and perished', two participles joined as a karmadhāraya, taken in order with the dvandva: arising with the opening, perishing with the closing. (3) bhuvana-āvalī 'the row of worlds' (ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa). (4) The whole is a bahuvrīhi: 'She by whose opening and closing of the eyes rows of worlds arise and perish'.

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning
उत्utup (prefix) — appears as un- before m
मेषmeṣaopening (of the eyes) — √miṣ 'to open the eyes'; unmeṣa 'opening'
निमिषnimiṣaclosing (of the eyes), a blink — ni + √miṣ
उत्पन्नutpannaarisen, born — ut + √pad, past participle
विपन्नvipannaperished, dissolved — vi + √pad, past participle
भुवनbhuvanaworld
आवलीāvalīrow, series, line

Complete meaning She at the opening and closing of whose eyes whole rows of worlds arise and perish

Spiritual significance Creation and dissolution cost Her no more than a blink. In Kashmir Śaivism unmeṣa and nimeṣa are also the unfolding and infolding of consciousness, by which the world appears and withdraws.

Uncertain A bahuvrīhi ending in an ī-stem like āvalī would by Pāṇini 5.4.153 normally take the suffix -ka (…āvalīkā); the name keeps -āvalī, which is common in such poetic compounds.

  • वर्णाश्रम → वर्ण + आश्रम (varṇa + āśrama) — savarṇa-dīrgha: a + a/ā → ā (Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ)
Samāsa vigraha

ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa (with an inner itaretara-dvandva)

varṇāḥ ca āśramāḥ ca varṇāśramāḥ; varṇāśramāṇām vidhāyinī varṇāśramavidhāyinī

Inner layer: varṇa-āśrama 'the classes and the stages of life' (dvandva). Outer layer: vidhāyinī 'she who ordains' (vi + √dhā with the agent suffix -in, y inserted after the ā, feminine -inī) is the head and takes them in the genitive.

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning

आश्रमāśramastage of life (student, householder, forest-dweller, renunciant)

Complete meaning She who ordains the order of the classes and the stages of life

Spiritual significance Traditionally the order of duties belongs to Her because the Vedas that teach it are Her command (name 287).

Corrected in this edition वर्णाश्रमविधायिनि → वर्णाश्रमविधायिनी. विधायिनि → विधायिनी: the nominative feminine ends in long ī (-inī).

Sandhi viccheda

nijā ājñā nijājñā; nijājñā rūpam yeṣām te nijājñārūpāḥ; nijājñārūpāḥ nigamāḥ yasyāḥ sā nijājñārūpanigamā

(1) nija-ājñā 'Her own command' (karmadhāraya). (2) nijājñā-rūpa 'having Her own command as their form', a bahuvrīhi qualifying nigama. (3) The whole is a bahuvrīhi: 'She whose Vedas have the form of Her own command'; nigama takes the feminine -ā.

upapada-tatpuruṣa (over an inner ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa and itaretara-dvandva)

puṇyam ca apuṇyam ca puṇyāpuṇye; puṇyāpuṇyayoḥ phalam puṇyāpuṇyaphalam; puṇyāpuṇyaphalam pradadāti iti puṇyāpuṇyaphalapradā

Sanskrit componentIASTLiteral English meaning
पुण्यpuṇyamerit, good deed
अपुण्यapuṇyademerit, evil deed — a- 'not' + puṇya

प्रदाpradāgiving, bestowing — pra + √dā, feminine
